words.en: A kinetochore is a protein structure on chromatids where the spindle fibers attach during cell division to pull the chromosomes apart.

words.ex: He takes lactase to digest milk.
words.ex_cn: 他服用乳糖酶来消化牛奶。
words.en: An enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of lactose to glucose and galactose.

words.ex: Muscles produce lactic acid during exercise.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉在运动时会产生乳酸。
words.en: Lactic acid is an organic acid that forms when certain bacteria ferment carbohydrates, or it is produced in muscle cells from the fermentation of glucose during strenuous exercise.

words.ex: The large intestine absorbs water from food.
words.ex_cn: 大肠从食物中吸收水分。
words.en: The part of the intestine that runs between the small intestine and the anus, where water is absorbed and feces are formed.

words.ex: The sun gives light energy to the plants.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给植物提供光能。
words.en: Light energy is a form of energy that is visible to the human eye and is responsible for the sense of sight. It is a type of electromagnetic radiation that is produced by the movement of charged particles.

words.ex: The doctor checked his lymph node for swelling.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的淋巴结是否有肿胀。
words.en: A lymph node is any of the glandular structures that are situated in various parts of the body and act as filters for the lymph, removing bacteria and other foreign particles.

words.ex: Lysosomes break down waste in cells.
words.ex_cn: 溶酶体分解细胞中的废物。
words.en: Lysosomes are membrane-bound organelles found in nearly all animal cells. They are responsible for breaking down waste materials and cellular debris.

words.ex: The medulla oblongata controls breathing and heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 延髓控制呼吸和心率。
words.en: The medulla oblongata is the lower half of the brainstem, which controls autonomic functions such as breathing, heart rate, and blood pressure.

words.ex: Cells undergo meiotic division to form sperm and eggs.
words.ex_cn: 细胞通过减数分裂形成精子和卵子。
words.en: The process of cell division in sexually reproducing organisms that reduces the number of chromosomes in the parent cell by half and produces four gamete cells.

words.ex: Meiosis produces four daughter cells from one parent cell.
words.ex_cn: 减数分裂从一个母细胞产生四个子细胞。
words.en: Meiosis is a process where a single cell divides twice to produce four cells containing half the original amount of genetic information. These cells are our sex cells – sperm in males, eggs in females.

words.ex: The muscular system helps us move.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉系统帮助我们运动。
words.en: The system in the body composed of muscle cells and tissues that allows for movement and posture maintenance.

words.tr: phrase. 自然选择；物竞天择
words.ex: Birds with strong beaks survive by natural selection.
words.ex_cn: 喙强的鸟通过自然选择生存下来。
words.en: The process by which forms of life having traits that better enable them to adapt to specific environmental pressures, as predators, changes in climate, or competition for food or mates, will tend to survive and reproduce in greater numbers than others of their kind, thus ensuring the perpetuation of those favorable traits in succeeding generations.

words.tr: n. 神经递质；神经传导物质
words.ex: The release of neurotransmitters in the brain affects mood and behavior.
words.ex_cn: 大脑中神经递质的释放会影响情绪和行为。
words.en: A neurotransmitter is a chemical substance that is released at the end of a nerve fiber by the arrival of a nerve impulse and, by diffusing across the synapse or junction, effects the transfer of the impulse to another nerve fiber, a muscle fiber, or some other structure.

words.ex: A bacterium is a unicellular organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种单细胞生物。
words.en: An organism consisting of a single cell, which performs all the functions necessary for life.

words.ex: DNA has four nitrogenous bases.
words.ex_cn: DNA有四种含氮碱基。
words.en: A nitrogenous base is an organic molecule that contains nitrogen and has the chemical properties of a base. These bases are crucial components of nucleotides, the building blocks of DNA and RNA.

words.ex: The nuclear membrane surrounds the nucleus in a cell.
words.ex_cn: 细胞核膜包围着细胞核。
words.en: The nuclear membrane is a double lipid bilayer membrane which surrounds the genetic material and nucleolus in eukaryotic cells.

words.ex: DNA is a type of nucleic acid.
words.ex_cn: DNA 是一种核酸。
words.en: A complex organic substance present in living cells, especially DNA or RNA, whose molecules consist of many nucleotides linked in a long chain.

words.ex: The nucleus of the team is the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的核心是队长。
words.en: The central and most important part of an object, movement, or group, forming the basis for its activity and growth.

words.ex: The octopus swims quickly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 章鱼在海里游得很快。
words.en: An octopus is a sea creature with a soft, oval body and eight long arms.

words.ex: The olfactory bulb helps us smell flowers.
words.ex_cn: 嗅球帮助我们闻到花香。
words.en: The olfactory bulb is a neural structure of the vertebrate forebrain involved in olfaction, the perception of odors.

words.ex: The dentist checks the oral cavity for cavities.
words.ex_cn: 牙医检查口腔是否有蛀牙。
words.en: The mouth, especially considered as the space bounded by the lips, teeth, and gums.

words.ex: The cells release signals in a paracrine way.
words.ex_cn: 细胞以旁分泌的方式释放信号。
words.en: Paracrine refers to a form of cell signaling in which the target cell is close to the signal-releasing cell, and the signaling molecules affect nearby cells.

words.tr: n. 单性生殖；孤雌生殖
words.ex: Some lizards can reproduce by parthenogenesis.
words.ex_cn: 一些蜥蜴可以通过孤雌生殖繁殖。
words.en: The development of an egg into an individual without fertilization, especially as a normal process in some invertebrates and lower plants.

words.ex: The stomach produces pepsinogen to help digest food.
words.ex_cn: 胃产生胃蛋白酶原以帮助消化食物。
words.en: A substance that is secreted by the stomach wall and converted into the enzyme pepsin by gastric acid.

words.ex: The peptide helps the body heal faster.
words.ex_cn: 这种肽帮助身体更快愈合。
words.en: A peptide is a compound consisting of two or more amino acids linked in a chain, the carboxyl group of each acid being joined to the amino group of the next by a bond known as a peptide bond.

words.ex: Peristalsis moves food through the intestines.
words.ex_cn: 蠕动将食物通过肠道推动。
words.en: The involuntary constriction and relaxation of the muscles of the intestine or another canal, creating wavelike movements that push the contents of the canal forward.

words.ex: The peroxisome breaks down fatty acids in the cell.
words.ex_cn: 过氧化物酶体在细胞中分解脂肪酸。
words.en: A peroxisome is a small organelle present in the cytoplasm of many cells, involved in the breakdown of very long chain fatty acids and the detoxification of hydrogen peroxide.

words.tr: n. 噬菌作用；吞噬作用
words.ex: Phagocytosis is a key process in the immune system.
words.ex_cn: 吞噬作用是免疫系统中的一个关键过程。
words.en: The process by which a cell engulfs and digests particles, such as bacteria or dead tissue cells.

words.ex: The plant's phenotype is tall with green leaves.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物的表型是高大且有绿叶。
words.en: The phenotype is the set of observable characteristics of an individual resulting from the interaction of its genotype with the environment.

words.ex: The phloem carries sugar from leaves to roots.
words.ex_cn: 韧皮部将糖从叶子运输到根部。
words.en: The tissue in plants that conducts food from the leaves to other parts of the plant.

words.ex: The cell membrane is made of phospholipid.
words.ex_cn: 细胞膜由磷脂组成。
words.en: A phospholipid is a lipid containing a phosphate group in its molecule, making it an essential component of cell membranes.

words.ex: The enzyme causes phosphorylation of the protein.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶使蛋白质发生磷酸化。
words.en: Phosphorylation is the biochemical process of adding a phosphate group to a molecule or ion.

words.ex: He uses a pipet to drop liquid into the test tube.
words.ex_cn: 他用移液管将液体滴入试管中。
words.en: A pipet is a slender tube used in laboratories to measure and transfer small quantities of liquid.

words.ex: The pituitary gland controls many body functions.
words.ex_cn: 垂体腺控制许多身体功能。
words.en: The pituitary gland is a small, pea-shaped gland located at the base of the brain, which produces hormones that regulate many functions of the body, including growth, blood pressure, and reproduction.

words.ex: The plasma membrane protects the cell.
words.ex_cn: 细胞膜保护细胞。
words.en: The plasma membrane is a biological membrane that separates the interior of all cells from the outside environment.

words.ex: Plasmodesmata connect plant cells.
words.ex_cn: 胞间连丝连接植物细胞。
words.en: Plasmodesmata are microscopic channels which traverse the cell walls of plant cells and some algal cells, enabling transport and communication between them.

words.ex: The cell makes a polypeptide from amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 细胞从氨基酸中合成多肽。
words.en: A polypeptide is a long, continuous, and unbranched peptide chain. Polypeptides are synthesized by the translation of mRNA and are used in the synthesis of proteins.

words.ex: The doctor found a polypus in his colon.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的结肠里发现了一个息肉。
words.en: A polypus is a small growth, usually benign, projecting from a mucous membrane, such as in the nose or colon.

words.ex: The prokaryotic cell has no nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 原核细胞没有细胞核。
words.en: A prokaryotic cell is a type of cell that does not have a true nucleus or membrane-bound organelles. Organisms within the domains Bacteria and Archaea are based on the prokaryotic cell, which is the earliest and most primitive form of life on Earth.

words.ex: The cell enters prophase before dividing.
words.ex_cn: 细胞在分裂前进入前期。
words.en: The first stage of cell division, before metaphase, during which the chromosomes become visible as paired chromatids and the nuclear envelope disappears.

words.tr: phrase. 径向对称；放射对称
words.ex: The starfish has radial symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 海星具有辐射对称性。
words.en: Radial symmetry is a type of symmetry in which the parts of an object are arranged around a central axis in a way that they are equally spaced.

words.ex: The recessive gene causes blue eyes in some children.
words.ex_cn: 隐性基因会导致一些孩子有蓝眼睛。
words.en: A recessive gene is a gene that can be masked by a dominant gene. In order for an individual to express a recessive trait, they must inherit two copies of the recessive gene, one from each parent.

words.ex: The reproductive system helps humans have babies.
words.ex_cn: 生殖系统帮助人类生育孩子。
words.en: The organs and parts of the body involved in the process of producing offspring.

words.ex: The respiratory system is crucial for the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide.
words.ex_cn: 呼吸系统对氧气和二氧化碳的交换至关重要。
words.en: The system in living organisms that takes in oxygen and expels carbon dioxide, involving the lungs and other structures.

words.ex: The stroma lamella is an essential component of the chloroplast structure.
words.ex_cn: 基质片层是叶绿体结构的重要组成部分。
words.en: A layer of the stroma in chloroplasts that is involved in the process of photosynthesis.

words.ex: Sulfur dioxide is a major air pollutant and contributes to acid rain formation.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化硫是一种主要的空气污染物，并有助于酸雨的形成。
words.en: Sulfur dioxide is a chemical compound with the formula SO₂. It is a toxic gas with a pungent, irritating smell, released by volcanoes and in various industrial processes.

words.ex: He adds sucrose to his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把蔗糖加进茶里。
words.en: Sucrose is a type of sugar that is commonly found in plants and is used as a sweetener in foods and beverages.

words.tr: n. 染色体结合； 联会；（神经元的）触处
words.ex: During meiosis, synapsis allows homologous chromosomes to pair up.
words.ex_cn: 在减数分裂期间，染色体联会使得同源染色体配对。
words.en: The process by which two homologous chromosomes pair up and exchange genetic material during meiosis.

words.ex: Telomeres protect the ends of chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 端粒保护染色体的末端。
words.en: A telomere is a region of repetitive nucleotide sequences at each end of a chromosome, which protects the end of the chromosome from deterioration or from fusion with neighboring chromosomes.

words.ex: During telophase, the chromosomes move to opposite poles of the cell.
words.ex_cn: 在末期，染色体向细胞的两极移动。
words.en: The final stage of mitosis or meiosis during which the chromosomes move to opposite ends of the cell and two nuclei are formed.

words.ex: The temperate forest is home to a diverse range of plant and animal species.
words.ex_cn: 温带森林是多种动植物的家园。
words.en: A temperate forest is a forest found between the tropical and boreal regions, located in the temperate zone. These forests are characterized by a distinct seasonal cycle, with a moderate climate and a wide variety of tree species.

words.ex: The temperate grassland is home to many species of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 温带草原是许多野生动物的家园。
words.en: A temperate grassland is a biome dominated by grasses and other herbaceous plants, with a temperate climate.

words.ex: The tertiary structure of a protein is crucial for its function.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质的三级结构对其功能至关重要。
words.en: The three-dimensional structure of a macromolecule, such as a protein or nucleic acid, resulting from the folding and coiling of its secondary structure.

words.tr: n. 四个一组；四分染色体
words.ex: The four books form a tetrad on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这四本书在书架上组成一组四个。
words.en: A group or set of four.

words.ex: Transgenic animals are used in research to study human diseases.
words.ex_cn: 转基因动物被用于研究以研究人类疾病。
words.en: A transgenic animal is one that has had genes from another species inserted into its genome.

words.ex: Monkeys live in the tropical rain forest.
words.ex_cn: 猴子生活在热带雨林中。
words.en: A tropical rain forest is a dense, warm, wet forest found in regions near the equator, characterized by high biodiversity and a significant amount of rainfall.

words.ex: The tropical savanna is characterized by its hot climate and large open areas with scattered trees.
words.ex_cn: 热带稀树草原的特点是气候炎热，有大片开阔地，零星分布着树木。
words.en: A tropical savanna is a grassland ecosystem characterized by the trees being sufficiently small or widely spaced so that the canopy does not close. The open canopy allows sufficient light to reach the ground to support an unbroken herbaceous layer consisting primarily of grasses.

words.ex: The seedling has developed its first true leaf.
words.ex_cn: 幼苗已经长出了第一片真叶。
words.en: The first true leaf that appears after the seed leaves in a plant.

words.ex: The plant cell has a large vacuole.
words.ex_cn: 植物细胞有一个大的液泡。
words.en: A vacuole is a space or vesicle within the cytoplasm of a cell, enclosed by a membrane and typically containing fluid.

words.ex: The scientists conducted experiments in a vacuum chamber to simulate space conditions.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们在真空室中进行实验，以模拟太空条件。
words.en: A vacuum chamber is a rigid enclosure from which air and other gases are removed by a vacuum pump.

words.ex: The vascular cambium is responsible for the secondary growth of plants.
words.ex_cn: 维管形成层负责植物的次生生长。
words.en: A layer of cells in a plant that produces secondary phloem and xylem and is responsible for secondary growth.

words.ex: The wild type strain was used as a control in the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 在实验中，野生型菌株被用作对照。
words.en: The wild type refers to the typical form of a species as it occurs in nature, not having been subjected to selective breeding or genetic modification.

words.ex: The xylem transports water and nutrients from the roots to the rest of the plant.
words.ex_cn: 木质部将水分和养分从根部输送到植物的其他部分。
words.en: The xylem is the tissue in plants that conducts water and dissolved nutrients upwards from the root and also helps to form the woody element in the stem.

words.tr: v. 闪烁；发火花；焕发才智
words.ex: The diamonds on her necklace scintillated under the light.
words.ex_cn: 她项链上的钻石在灯光下闪闪发光。
words.en: To emit sparks or to sparkle; to twinkle; to be brilliant or lively in conversation or performance.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: He asked for clarification about the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他要求对规则进行澄清。
words.en: A clarification is a statement that makes something clear or easier to understand.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: The garden was filled with colorful shrubbery.
words.ex_cn: 花园里种满了五彩缤纷的灌木。
words.en: A shrubbery is a part of a garden where shrubs are planted.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。
words.en: A volatile situation or person is one that is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse.

words.ex: The lab uses anhydrous ethanol for experiments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用无水乙醇进行实验。
words.en: Anhydrous substances do not contain water.

words.ex: He buys gasoline for his car every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周为他的汽车买汽油。
words.en: Gasoline is a volatile, flammable liquid obtained from petroleum and used as fuel in internal combustion engines.

words.ex: The recipe calls for a mixture of flour and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和水的混合物。
words.en: A mixture is a substance made by combining other substances together.

words.tr: n. 长颈瓶；烧瓶；携带用扁瓶；保温瓶
words.ex: He poured the liquid into a glass flask.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒进了一个玻璃长颈瓶里。
words.en: A flask is a bottle or other container which is used in science laboratories and industry for holding liquids.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: n. 沸腾；煮沸； v. 煮沸；“boil”的现在分词； adj. 很热的；
words.ex: The boiling of water happens at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水的沸腾发生在100摄氏度。
words.en: The process of heating a liquid until it begins to turn into a gas, or the state of being very hot.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr:
n. 盐水；卤水；咸水；海水
v. 用盐水处理
words.ex: She put the fish in brine to preserve it.
words.ex_cn: 她把鱼放在盐水中腌制以保存它。
words.en: Brine is water that contains a high concentration of salt, used especially for preserving food.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.tr:
n. 胶质；胶体
adj. 胶体的
words.ex: The mixture forms a colloid when shaken.
words.ex_cn: 摇晃后，这种混合物会形成胶状体。
words.en: A colloid is a substance consisting of particles that are dispersed throughout another substance and are too small to be seen with the naked eye, but are larger than molecules.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；“burn”的现在分词； adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；
words.ex: The wood is burning in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头正在壁炉里燃烧。
words.en: A burning issue or problem is very important and needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.tr:
adj. 掺杂用的
n. 掺杂物
words.ex: The food was contaminated by an adulterant called melamine.
words.ex_cn: 这种食品被一种叫三聚氰胺的掺杂物污染了。
words.en: An adulterant is a substance used to adulterate another substance, often for the purpose of reducing the quality or increasing the quantity of the original substance.

words.ex: The distillation of water removes impurities.
words.ex_cn: 水的蒸馏过程可以去除杂质。
words.en: The process of purifying a liquid by heating it until it becomes a vapor and then cooling the vapor to collect the purified liquid.

words.ex: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味充满了厨房。
words.en: An aroma is a strong, pleasant smell.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr:
v. 加酵母；使发酵；影响
n. 酵素；酵母；潜移默化的影响
words.ex: She uses yeast to leaven the bread.
words.ex_cn: 她用酵母使面包发酵。
words.en: Leaven is a substance, typically yeast, that is used in dough to make it rise. It can also refer to something that modifies or lightens a situation or atmosphere.

words.ex: The car burns hydrocarbon fuel.
words.ex_cn: 汽车燃烧碳氢化合物燃料。
words.en: A hydrocarbon is an organic compound consisting entirely of hydrogen and carbon.

words.tr: adj. 有气味的；有臭气的
words.ex: The trash is odorous after being left in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾在阳光下放久了会有气味。
words.en: Having a distinctive smell, especially an unpleasant one.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阳极；（原电池的）负极
words.ex: The current flows into the anode during electrolysis.
words.ex_cn: 在电解过程中，电流流入阳极。
words.en: An anode is the positively charged electrode by which the electrons leave a device.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: He pours water into the beaker.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进烧杯里。
words.en: A beaker is a glass or plastic container used in laboratories. It is cylindrical in shape, with a flat bottom and a small spout for pouring.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: Sodium hydroxide is a strong base.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种强碱。
words.en: A hydroxide is a chemical compound containing an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom, which can dissociate in water to produce hydroxide ions.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The change is reversible under normal conditions.
words.ex_cn: 在正常条件下，这种变化是可逆的。
words.en: Capable of being reversed; able to return to an original state or condition.

words.tr: adj. 不稳定的；飘忽不定的；
words.ex: The weather has been erratic this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月的天气一直不稳定。
words.en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves in unexpected directions.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阴极；（原电池的）正极
words.ex: In a battery, the cathode is the positive terminal.
words.ex_cn: 在电池中，阴极是正极。
words.en: The cathode is the electrode from which a conventional current leaves a polarized electrical device.

words.ex: The residual water dried up quickly.
words.ex_cn: 残留的水很快就干了。
words.en: Remaining after the greater part or quantity has gone.

words.ex: The rocket engine uses liquid oxygen as an oxidizer.
words.ex_cn: 火箭发动机使用液态氧作为氧化剂。
words.en: A substance that oxidizes another substance in a chemical reaction by accepting electrons.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: The minuscule dot was hard to see with the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 那个极小的点用肉眼很难看到。
words.en: If you describe something as minuscule, you mean that it is very small.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: This isotope is used in medical tests.
words.ex_cn: 这种同位素用于医学检查。
words.en: An isotope is one of two or more forms of the same chemical element. Different isotopes of an element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.tr: n. 冲刷；冲蚀；彻底失败；清洗内部
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a washout on the road.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致道路被冲刷。
words.en: A washout is an event or situation that is a complete failure, or a place where soil has been removed by water.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人不愉快的
words.ex: The noisome smell made everyone leave the room.
words.ex_cn: 那股难闻的气味让所有人都离开了房间。
words.en: If you describe something as noisome, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, especially because it has a very strong or bad smell.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: The purity of the water is checked every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天都会检查水的纯净度。
words.en: The quality or state of being pure, especially in terms of being free from anything that contaminates, pollutes, or dilutes.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: The sign says the material is inflammable.
words.ex_cn: 标志上说这种材料是易燃的。
words.en: Easily set on fire; capable of burning quickly and intensely.

words.ex: The lab uses a special reagent to test water.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用一种特殊的试剂来检测水。
words.en: A reagent is a substance or compound that is added to a system in order to bring about a chemical reaction, or added to see if a reaction occurs.

words.ex: Phosphorus is in some fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 磷存在于一些肥料中。
words.en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with the symbol P and atomic number 15. It is a nonmetal that is essential for life, found in DNA, RNA, ATP, and the phospholipids that form all cell membranes.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He uses gypsum to make plaster for walls.
words.ex_cn: 他用石膏来制作墙面的灰泥。
words.en: A soft white or gray mineral consisting of hydrated calcium sulfate, used in making plaster of Paris and in the building industry.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.tr:
n.  水合物；氢氧化物
v. （使）成水合物
words.ex: The crystal is a hydrate of copper sulfate.
words.ex_cn: 这种晶体是硫酸铜的水合物。
words.en: To hydrate means to cause something to absorb water or to supply water or liquid to someone or something in order to maintain healthy bodily functions. It can also refer to a compound, typically a crystalline one, in which water molecules are chemically bound to another compound or an element.

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.ex: He imbibes coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喝咖啡。
words.en: To imbibe means to drink, especially alcohol, or to absorb or take in something, such as knowledge or ideas.

words.ex: The homogeneity of the sample made the test results reliable.
words.ex_cn: 样本的同种性使测试结果可靠。
words.en: The quality or state of being all the same or all of the same kind.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.ex: Morphine is an alkaloid derived from opium.
words.ex_cn: 吗啡是从鸦片中提取的一种生物碱。
words.en: An alkaloid is a naturally occurring chemical compound containing basic nitrogen atoms. This group also includes some related compounds with neutral and even weakly acidic properties. Some synthetic compounds of similar structure may also be termed alkaloids.

words.ex: The nurse used forceps to pick up the small bandage.
words.ex_cn: 护士用镊子夹起小块纱布。
words.en: A forceps is a hand-held, hinged instrument used for grasping and holding objects. Forceps are used when fingers are too large to grasp small objects or when many objects need to be held at one time while the hands are used to perform a task.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The incandescent bulb gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 白炽灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: Emitting light as a result of being heated.

words.tr: n. 冷却；降温； v. “cool”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cooling of the engine takes about ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 发动机的冷却需要大约十分钟。
words.en: The process of becoming cooler; a reduction in temperature.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: Salt water causes corrosion on metal.
words.ex_cn: 盐水会导致金属腐蚀。
words.en: Corrosion is the process in which a metal is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction, usually with oxygen or water.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.tr: abbr. 一种铝合金型号（Aluminium Alloy 2980）；也可指特定设备或零件的编号
words.ex: Al2980 is a code used in the lab.
words.ex_cn: Al2980是实验室中使用的一个代码。
words.en: Al is the chemical symbol for aluminum, a lightweight, silvery-white metal that is widely used in various industries due to its properties such as corrosion resistance and high conductivity.

words.ex: The trucks stop at the depot to load goods.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在仓库停靠以装载货物。
words.en: A depot is a place where large amounts of raw materials, manufactured goods, or equipment are stored until they are needed.

words.ex: Cleanliness is important for good health.
words.ex_cn: 清洁对健康很重要。
words.en: Cleanliness is the state or quality of being clean or kept clean.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.tr:
v. 反驳；回嘴
n. 反驳；顶嘴
words.ex: He gave a quick retort when she criticized him.
words.ex_cn: 当她批评他时，他迅速回了一句。
words.en: If you retort, you reply angrily to someone.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: Heat will liquefy the ice.
words.ex_cn: 加热会使冰融化。
words.en: To make or become liquid.

words.ex: The fetid smell came from the old trash.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自旧垃圾。
words.en: Having an extremely unpleasant smell.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: The artist commingled various colors to create a unique hue.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家混合了各种颜色，创造出一种独特的色调。
words.en: To commingle means to mix or blend different things together.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The rain acidifies the soil.
words.ex_cn: 雨水使土壤酸化。
words.en: To make or become acid.

words.tr: adj. 无害的；无冒犯之意的
words.ex: The comment was innocuous and didn't upset anyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个评论无害，没有惹恼任何人。
words.en: Something that is innocuous is not harmful or offensive.

words.tr: v. 使减细；使减小；使减弱
words.ex: The wire attenuates as it gets longer.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线随着变长而变细。
words.en: To reduce the force, effect, or value of something.

words.ex: He found a piece of metal in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里发现了一块金属。
words.en: Metal is a hard, shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel.

words.tr: n. 含酒精的饮料；酒精；
words.ex: He drank alcohol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上喝了含酒精的饮料。
words.en: Alcohol is a colourless liquid that can make you drunk, and which is used in medicines, cleaning products, and other substances.

words.tr:
v. 落下；
adj. 点亮的；
words.ex: The bird alighted on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟落在了树上。
words.en: If someone alights from a vehicle or if they alight, they get out of it after a journey.

words.tr:
adv. 着火地；燃烧地；激动地
adj. 着火的；燃烧的；炽烈的
words.ex: The house is afire after the lightning strike.
words.ex_cn: 房子在雷击后着火了。
words.en: If something is afire, it is on fire or burning.

words.ex: The wound was cleaned with saline water.
words.ex_cn: 伤口用盐水清洗。
words.en: Saline is used to describe something that contains salt or is related to salt.

words.tr:
v. 聚成块；聚成堆；凝聚
adj. 成团的；结块的；聚结的
n. 团块；凝聚物；集块岩
words.ex: The dust particles tend to agglomerate in the presence of moisture.
words.ex_cn: 在有湿气的情况下，灰尘颗粒往往会结块。
words.en: To agglomerate means to gather into a cluster or mass, or to cause to gather into such a cluster or mass. As a noun, it refers to a mass or collection of things; a cluster.

words.ex: The bottle is made of a strong polymer.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是由一种坚固的聚合物制成的。
words.en: A polymer is a chemical compound with molecules bonded together in long repeating chains. Because of their structure, polymers have unique properties that can be tailored for different uses.

words.tr: n. 不纯，不洁；杂质；不纯的东西
words.ex: The water has an impurity that makes it unsafe to drink.
words.ex_cn: 水中有一种杂质，使其不适合饮用。
words.en: An impurity is a substance of a different type that is mixed with another substance, often making it less pure.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: Fe is essential for the formation of hemoglobin.
words.ex_cn: 铁对于血红蛋白的形成是必不可少的。
words.en: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron, a metallic element that is a common material in the construction of buildings and tools.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.tr: v. 焚化；焚毁；把…烧成灰烬
words.ex: The city will incinerate the trash tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市明天将焚烧垃圾。
words.en: To incinerate something means to burn it until it is reduced to ash.

words.ex: The spray can releases an aerosol into the air.
words.ex_cn: 喷雾罐将气溶胶释放到空气中。
words.en: An aerosol is a suspension of fine solid particles or liquid droplets in air or another gas.

words.ex: The factory uses bauxite to make aluminum.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂用铝土矿来制造铝。
words.en: Bauxite is a clay-like mineral which is the main ore of aluminum. It consists largely of the minerals gibbsite, boehmite, and diaspore, mixed with the two iron oxides goethite and hematite, the clay mineral kaolinite, and small amounts of anatase.

words.ex: The car won't start because the ignition is broken.
words.ex_cn: 汽车无法启动，因为点火器坏了。
words.en: The process of starting the combustion of fuel in an engine.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: The anemometer measures the speed of the wind.
words.ex_cn: 风速计测量风速。
words.en: An anemometer is a device for measuring the speed of the wind, or of any current of gas.

words.ex: He hurt his body while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤到了身体。
words.en: The physical structure of a person or an animal, including the bones, flesh, and organs.

words.ex: The virulent virus spread quickly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 这种剧毒的病毒迅速在小镇上传播。
words.en: A virulent disease or poison is extremely powerful and dangerous.

words.tr: n. 密封胶；密封剂；防渗漏剂
words.ex: The plumber applied a sealant to prevent water leakage.
words.ex_cn: 水管工涂抹了密封剂以防止漏水。
words.en: A sealant is a substance used to seal something so as to prevent it from leaking or to protect it.

words.tr: adj. 刺鼻的；一语道破的
words.ex: The cheese has a pungent smell.
words.ex_cn: 这种奶酪有刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Having a sharply strong taste or smell.

words.ex: The luminescent fish glow in the dark ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这些发冷光的鱼在黑暗的海洋中发光。
words.en: Something that is luminescent shines or glows in the dark.

words.ex: The farmer aerates the soil to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民给土壤通气以帮助植物生长。
words.en: To aerate something means to expose it to air or to cause air to circulate through it, often to keep it fresh or to improve its quality.

words.ex: The plant needs phosphate to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要磷酸盐才能良好生长。
words.en: A phosphate is a salt or ester of phosphoric acid, containing the anion PO₄³⁻ or the group —PO₄.

words.ex: He poured the liquid into a test tube.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒进试管里。
words.en: A test tube is a thin glass tube closed at one end, used in scientific experiments to hold small amounts of liquid.

words.tr: n. 长柄勺；浸染工；北斗七星
words.ex: He uses a dipper to pour water from the bucket.
words.ex_cn: 他用瓢从桶里舀水。
words.en: A dipper is a ladle or scoop used for dipping liquids. It can also refer to the Big Dipper, a well-known constellation, or to a person who dips something in a liquid.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.tr: adj. 醋的；醋酸的；乙酸的
words.ex: The smell of acetic acid was overpowering.
words.ex_cn: 乙酸的气味非常刺鼻。
words.en: Relating to or containing acetic acid or vinegar.

words.ex: The amalgamation of cultures led to a unique artistic style.
words.ex_cn: 文化的融合催生了一种独特的艺术风格。
words.en: The process of combining or uniting multiple entities into one.

words.ex: The company made a titanic effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司做出了巨大的努力来按时完成项目。
words.en: If you describe something as titanic, you mean that it is very big or important, and usually that it involves very powerful forces.

words.tr: n. 使无效；中和；中和作用
words.ex: The neutralization of the acid took place in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 酸的中和反应在实验室里发生了。
words.en: The process of making something chemically neutral, especially by adding an acid to a base or vice versa.

words.ex: The doctor checked his glucose level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血糖水平。
words.en: A simple sugar which is an important energy source in living organisms and is a component of many carbohydrates.

words.ex: The iron will oxidize in wet air.
words.ex_cn: 铁在潮湿的空气中会氧化。
words.en: To combine or become combined chemically with oxygen.

words.ex: Ethylene helps fruits ripen faster.
words.ex_cn: 乙烯有助于水果更快成熟。
words.en: A colorless flammable gas, C2H4, derived from natural gas and petroleum and used as a source of many organic compounds, in welding and cutting metals, and in ripening fruits.

words.ex: Graphene is the thinnest material known to man.
words.ex_cn: 石墨烯是人类已知的最薄材料。
words.en: Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a two-dimensional honeycomb lattice. It is known for its exceptional strength, conductivity, and flexibility, making it a material of great interest in various fields of science and technology.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

chapters.name: 专业词汇 其他化学常用术语：

words.tr: n. 醋酸盐；醋酸酯；乙酸盐；乙酸酯
words.ex: The film is made from cellulose acetate.
words.ex_cn: 这种胶片是由醋酸纤维素制成的。
words.en: A salt or ester of acetic acid, or a synthetic textile fiber made from cellulose acetate.

words.ex: Acid anhydrides are commonly used in the synthesis of organic compounds.
words.ex_cn: 酸酐通常用于有机化合物的合成。
words.en: An acid anhydride is a compound that reacts with water to form an acid.

words.ex: Acid rain kills trees and fish.
words.ex_cn: 酸雨杀死树木和鱼类。
words.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes environmental harm, typically to forests and lakes. The main cause is the industrial burning of coal and other fossil fuels, the waste gases from which contain sulfur and nitrogen oxides which combine with atmospheric water to form acids.

words.ex: Acid salts are formed when an acid reacts with a base.
words.ex_cn: 酸式盐是在酸与碱反应时形成的。
words.en: An acid salt is a compound that results from the partial neutralization of a diprotic or polyprotic acid, containing both hydrogen ions and another cation.

words.ex: Acid-base neutralization titration is commonly used in analytical chemistry to determine the concentration of acids or bases in a solution.
words.ex_cn: 酸碱中和滴定在分析化学中常用于确定溶液中酸或碱的浓度。
words.en: A laboratory method used to determine the concentration of an acid or base by neutralizing it with a base or acid of known concentration.

words.ex: Acidic oxides are often found in nature as components of minerals.
words.ex_cn: 酸性氧化物在自然界中常以矿物成分的形式存在。
words.en: An acidic oxide is an oxide that reacts with water to form an acid, or with a base to form a salt.

words.ex: Actinium is a radioactive element used in some cancer treatments.
words.ex_cn: 锕是一种用于某些癌症治疗的放射性元素。
words.en: A radioactive chemical element with atomic number 89, discovered in 1899.

words.ex: Ac is a radioactive element in the periodic table.
words.ex_cn: Ac是元素周期表中的一种放射性元素。
words.en: A unit of electric current equal to one coulomb per second.

words.ex: An addition reaction typically involves the combination of two reactants to form a single product.
words.ex_cn: 加成反应通常涉及两个反应物结合形成单一产物。
words.en: A chemical reaction in which two or more molecules combine to form a larger one, with no other products.

words.tr: phrase. 空气排放；空气放电
words.ex: The air discharge from the cooling tower is carefully monitored to ensure it meets environmental standards.
words.ex_cn: 冷却塔的空气排放受到严格监控，以确保其符合环保标准。
words.en: The release of air into the environment, often referring to the process of removing or expelling air from a system or container.

words.tr: n. 除气；排气；消毒; v. 除气；给……排气；消毒（degas 的现在分词）
words.ex: The process of degassing is crucial in preventing bubbles in the molten metal.
words.ex_cn: 除气过程对于防止熔融金属中的气泡至关重要。
words.en: The process of removing gas from a liquid or solid.

words.ex: Formaldehyde is a simple aldehyde used in labs.
words.ex_cn: 甲醛是一种用于实验室的简单醛。
words.en: An aldehyde is an organic compound containing a formyl group, which is a functional group with the structure -CHO, consisting of a carbonyl center (a carbon double-bonded to oxygen) bonded to hydrogen and an R group.

words.ex: Alkali metals are highly reactive and are often stored in oil to prevent oxidation.
words.ex_cn: 碱金属非常活泼，通常储存在油中以防止氧化。
words.en: An alkali metal is any of the elements lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium, cesium, and francium, occupying Group IA (1) of the periodic table. They are very reactive, electropositive, monovalent metals.

words.ex: The alkalinity of the water is measured to ensure it is safe for drinking.
words.ex_cn: 水的碱度被测量以确保其适合饮用。
words.en: Alkalinity refers to the capacity of water to neutralize acids, a property imparted by the water's content of carbonate, bicarbonate, hydroxide, and occasionally borate, silicate, and phosphate.

words.ex: The process of alkalinization can alter the soil's pH level.
words.ex_cn: 碱化过程可以改变土壤的pH值。
words.en: The process of making something alkaline or increasing its pH level.

words.tr: phrase. 烷基衍生物； 烃基衍生物
words.ex: An alkyl derivative is a compound formed by the substitution of one or more hydrogen atoms in an alkane.
words.ex_cn: 烷基衍生物是通过在烷烃中替换一个或多个氢原子而形成的化合物。
words.en: A chemical compound derived from an alkyl group.

words.ex: The alkylation reaction is a common process in the petrochemical industry.
words.ex_cn: 烷基化反应是石化工业中的常见过程。
words.en: A chemical reaction in which an alkyl group is transferred from one molecule to another.

words.ex: Aluminum hydroxide is commonly used in antacids to neutralize stomach acid.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化铝常用于抗酸剂中以中和胃酸。
words.en: A chemical compound with the formula Al(OH)3, used in various applications including as an antacid and in the manufacture of other aluminum compounds.

words.ex: Americium is a radioactive element used in smoke detectors.
words.ex_cn: 镅是一种用于烟雾探测器的放射性元素。
words.en: Americium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Am and atomic number 95. It is a transuranic member of the actinide series, in the periodic table located under the lanthanide element europium, and thus by analogy was named after the Americas.

words.tr:
v. 是；动词be的第一人称单数现在式
abbr. 上午；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: I am happy today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天很开心。
words.en: first person singular present of be

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: An amino acid is a type of organic acid that contains both a carboxyl group and an amino group, and is a basic component of proteins.

words.ex: Ammonia water is commonly used as a cleaning agent.
words.ex_cn: 氨水常被用作清洁剂。
words.en: Ammonia water is a solution of ammonia in water, commonly used in cleaning and as a reagent in laboratories.

words.ex: Ammonium bicarbonate is commonly used in baking to help dough rise.
words.ex_cn: 氢碳酸铵常用于烘焙中帮助面团发酵。
words.en: Ammonium bicarbonate is a chemical compound with the formula NH4HCO3. It is a white crystalline solid that is used in baking as a leavening agent and in fire extinguishers as a source of carbon dioxide.

words.ex: Ammonium chloride is commonly used in dry cell batteries.
words.ex_cn: 氯化铵常用于干电池中。
words.en: A white crystalline salt used in dry cells and as a fertilizer and flux.

words.ex: Ammonium salts are widely used in fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 铵盐广泛用于肥料中。
words.en: An ammonium salt is a compound formed by the reaction of ammonia with an acid, consisting of the ammonium cation NH4+ and an anion.

words.ex: Ammonium sulfate is commonly used as a fertilizer due to its high nitrogen content.
words.ex_cn: 硫酸铵因其高氮含量而常用作肥料。
words.en: Ammonium sulfate is an inorganic salt with a variety of uses, the most common of which is as a soil fertilizer. It contains 21% nitrogen and 24% sulfur.

words.ex: The amount of substance in a chemical reaction is measured in moles.
words.ex_cn: 化学反应中物质的量以摩尔为单位进行测量。
words.en: The term 'amount of substance' refers to a quantity that measures the number of elementary entities (such as atoms, molecules, ions, electrons, or other particles) in a sample of matter. It is a fundamental quantity in chemistry and is expressed in moles.

words.ex: Aluminum oxide is an example of an amphoteric oxide.
words.ex_cn: 氧化铝是两性氧化物的一个例子。
words.en: An amphoteric oxide is a chemical compound that can react both as an acid and as a base.

words.ex: Starch, also known as amylum, is a carbohydrate consisting of a large number of glucose units joined by glycosidic bonds.
words.ex_cn: 淀粉，也被称为amylum，是一种由大量葡萄糖单元通过糖苷键连接而成的碳水化合物。
words.en: Amylum is a carbohydrate that is stored in plants, used as a source of energy.

words.ex: Acetic anhydride is commonly used in organic synthesis.
words.ex_cn: 乙酸酐常用于有机合成中。
words.en: A compound derived from an acid by removal of water.

words.ex: The anion is attracted to the anode in an electrolytic cell.
words.ex_cn: 阴离子在电解池中被阳极吸引。
words.en: An anion is a negatively charged ion, which is attracted to the anode in electrolysis.

words.tr: n. 锑（元素符号为 Sb）
words.ex: Antimony is used in the production of semiconductor devices.
words.ex_cn: 锑元素用于半导体器件的生产。
words.en: Antimony is a chemical element with the symbol Sb and atomic number 51. A lustrous gray metalloid, it is found in nature mainly as the sulfide mineral stibnite.

words.ex: Sb must have left the door open.
words.ex_cn: 某人一定把门打开了。
words.en: An abbreviation for 'somebody' or 'someone'.

words.ex: Aqua regia is a highly corrosive mixture of nitric acid and hydrochloric acid.
words.ex_cn: 王水是硝酸和盐酸的高度腐蚀性混合物。
words.en: A highly corrosive mixture of nitric acid and hydrochloric acid in a 1:3 ratio, capable of dissolving gold and platinum.

words.ex: The bulb is filled with argon gas.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡里充满了氩气。
words.en: Argon is a chemical element with the symbol Ar and atomic number 18. It is in group 18 of the periodic table and is a noble gas.

words.ex: They are happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们很高兴。
words.en: Are is the second person singular and plural, and first and third person plural of the present tense of 'be'.

words.ex: Arsenic is a poisonous element found in some water.
words.ex_cn: 砷是一种存在于某些水源中的有毒元素。
words.en: A very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.ex: Astatine is one of the rarest elements in the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 砹是地壳中最稀有的元素之一。
words.en: Astatine is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol At and atomic number 85. It is the heaviest known halogen and exists in nature only in trace amounts.

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把球朝窗户扔去。
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: The atomic mass of carbon is approximately 12.011 amu.
words.ex_cn: 碳的原子质量约为12.011原子质量单位。
words.en: The mass of an atom, usually expressed in atomic mass units (amu), which is approximately equal to the number of protons and neutrons in the atom.

words.ex: The atomic number of carbon is 6.
words.ex_cn: 碳的原子序数是6。
words.en: The atomic number of an element is the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom of that element.

words.ex: The atomic radius is a measure of the size of an atom.
words.ex_cn: 原子半径是衡量原子大小的一个指标。
words.en: The atomic radius is a measure of the size of its atoms, usually the mean or typical distance from the center of the nucleus to the boundary of the surrounding cloud of electrons.

words.ex: The atomic weight of carbon is approximately 12 atomic mass units.
words.ex_cn: 碳的原子量大约是12个原子质量单位。
words.en: The atomic weight of an element is the average mass of atoms of an element, calculated using the relative abundance of isotopes in a naturally-occurring element. It is expressed in atomic mass units (amu).

words.ex: Avogadro's constant is used in calculations involving the number of particles in a given amount of substance.
words.ex_cn: 阿伏伽德罗常数用于涉及给定物质中粒子数量的计算。
words.en: Avogadro's constant is the number of constituent particles, usually atoms or molecules, that are contained in the amount of substance given by one mole. It is approximately 6.02214076×10^23 mol^−1.

words.ex: The balance weight in the car's wheels helps to distribute the load evenly.
words.ex_cn: 汽车车轮中的平衡重量有助于均匀分配载荷。
words.en: A balance weight is a weight used to counterbalance or stabilize another weight or object, ensuring equilibrium.

words.tr: n. 平衡物；平衡力；砝码
words.ex: The counterweight on the scale helps to balance the load.
words.ex_cn: 天平上的平衡物有助于平衡负载。
words.en: A counterweight is a weight that balances another weight. In machinery, it is often used to balance the weight of the moving parts or to provide stability.

words.ex: The blacksmith used bar iron to forge the horseshoe.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠使用条铁来锻造马蹄铁。
words.en: A form of iron that has been processed into a long, narrow shape, used in construction and manufacturing.

words.ex: Barium is a chemical element with the symbol Ba and atomic number 56.
words.ex_cn: 钡是一种化学元素，符号为Ba，原子序数为56。
words.en: Barium is a chemical element with the symbol Ba and atomic number 56. It is a soft, silvery alkaline earth metal.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.ex: Calcium oxide is a typical basic oxide that reacts with acids to form salts and water.
words.ex_cn: 氧化钙是一种典型的碱性氧化物，能与酸反应生成盐和水。
words.en: A basic oxide is an oxide that shows basic properties, especially in aqueous solution, and reacts with acids to form salts.

words.ex: Basic salts are salts that contain hydroxide ions.
words.ex_cn: 碱式盐是含有氢氧根离子的盐。
words.en: A basic salt is a salt that is formed from a base and an acid, and which has a pH greater than 7.

words.ex: Berkelium is a synthetic element with the symbol Bk.
words.ex_cn: 锫是一种合成元素，符号为 Bk。
words.en: Berkelium is a synthetic element with the symbol Bk and atomic number 97. It is a member of the actinide and transuranium element series.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: Beryllium is a lightweight, strong metal used in aerospace applications.
words.ex_cn: 铍是一种轻质、坚固的金属，用于航空航天应用。
words.en: A hard, brittle, gray-white metallic element of the alkaline earth metals group, used in the manufacture of aerospace materials and X-ray windows.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 铋（元素符号为 Bi）
words.ex: Bismuth is used in certain medical treatments.
words.ex_cn: 铋用于某些医疗治疗。
words.en: Bismuth is a chemical element with the symbol Bi and atomic number 83. It is a brittle metal with a silvery white color when freshly produced, but surface oxidation can give it a pink tinge. Bismuth is the most naturally diamagnetic element and has one of the lowest values of thermal conductivity among metals.

words.ex: Bismuth, or Bi, is a metal used in medicines.
words.ex_cn: 铋，或 Bi，是一种用于药物的金属。
words.en: A prefix meaning "two" or "twice", used in the formation of compound words.

words.tr: n. 硼（元素符号为 B）
words.ex: Boron is a chemical element with the symbol B and atomic number 5.
words.ex_cn: 硼是一种化学元素，符号为B，原子序数为5。
words.en: Boron is a chemical element with the symbol B and atomic number 5. It is a metalloid, which means it has properties of both metals and nonmetals. Boron is used in a variety of applications, including in the production of glass and ceramics, as a semiconductor dopant, and in detergents and bleaches.

words.tr: n. 溴（元素符号为 Br）
words.ex: Bromine is a chemical element with the symbol Br.
words.ex_cn: 溴是一种化学元素，符号为Br。
words.en: Bromine is a chemical element with the symbol Br and atomic number 35. It is a halogen, and is a fuming red-brown liquid at room temperature that evaporates readily to form a similarly coloured gas.

words.tr:
abbr. 银行贴现率；“Bank Rate”的缩写
abbr. 英国铁路公司；“British Rail”的缩写
words.ex: He braked suddenly to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他突然刹车以避开那只狗。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Br) that is a reddish-brown liquid at room temperature, used in flame retardants and as a disinfectant.

words.ex: The phenomenon of Brownian motion can be observed under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 布朗运动现象在显微镜下可以观察到。
words.en: Brownian motion is the random motion of particles suspended in a fluid (a liquid or a gas) resulting from their collision with the quick atoms or molecules in the gas or liquid.

words.ex: The chemist used a Bunsen burner to heat the solution.
words.ex_cn: n. 化学家用本生灯加热溶液。
words.en: A Bunsen burner is a small adjustable gas burner used in laboratories as a source of heat.

words.tr: n. [分化]滴定管；玻璃量管; n. （Buret）人名；（法）比雷；（英）巴里特
words.ex: The chemist used a buret to measure the liquid accurately.
words.ex_cn: 化学家使用滴定管来准确测量液体。
words.en: A buret is a graduated glass tube with a tap at one end, used for delivering known volumes of a liquid, especially in titrations.

words.ex: The chemist carefully measured the solution into the burette.
words.ex_cn: 化学家小心地将溶液量入滴定管中。
words.en: A burette is a graduated glass tube with a tap at one end, used for delivering known volumes of a liquid, especially in titrations.

words.tr: n. 镉（元素符号为 Cd）
words.ex: Cadmium is a toxic heavy metal often found in industrial waste.
words.ex_cn: 镉是一种常在工业废物中发现的毒性重金属。
words.en: Cadmium is a soft, bluish-white metallic element that is used in batteries and pigments.

words.tr: abbr. 激光唱片；光盘；“Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: I bought a cd of my favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张我最爱歌曲的激光唱片。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cd) that is a soft, bluish-white metal, often used in batteries and pigments, and is toxic.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开车去上班。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: Californium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cf.
words.ex_cn: 锎是一种放射性化学元素，符号为 Cf。
words.en: Californium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cf and atomic number 98. It was first synthesized in 1950 at the University of California, Berkeley by bombarding curium with alpha particles.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. （拉丁）比较 【拉丁文 confer (=compare) 之略】
words.ex: See the discussion cf. the previous chapter.
words.ex_cn: 参见上一章的讨论。
words.en: Used in writing to introduce something that should be compared with the thing just mentioned.

words.ex: The phenomenon of calorescence is often observed in high-energy environments.
words.ex_cn: 发光热线现象通常在高能环境中被观察到。
words.en: The emission of light by a body as a result of its high temperature.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr: n. 催化作用；触媒作用
words.ex: The enzyme speeds up the reaction through catalysis.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶通过催化作用加快反应速度。
words.en: Catalysis is the process of increasing the rate of a chemical reaction by adding a substance known as a catalyst, which is not consumed in the reaction.

words.ex: Catalytic oxidation is a key process in the production of methanol from methane.
words.ex_cn: 催化氧化是将甲烷转化为甲醇的关键过程。
words.en: Catalytic oxidation refers to the process in which a substance is oxidized with the help of a catalyst, speeding up the reaction without being consumed in the process.

words.ex: The catalytic reaction significantly increased the efficiency of the process.
words.ex_cn: 催化反应显著提高了过程的效率。
words.en: A catalytic reaction is a chemical reaction that is accelerated by a catalyst, which is not consumed in the reaction.

words.ex: The mechanic placed a catch pan under the car to collect any oil that might leak during the repair.
words.ex_cn: 机械师在车下放置了一个接油盘，以收集修理过程中可能泄漏的任何油。
words.en: A shallow pan or tray placed under machinery or pipes to catch drips, leaks, or condensation.

words.ex: In chemistry, a cation is an ion with a positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 在化学中，阳离子是带正电的离子。
words.en: A cation is a positively charged ion, which is attracted to the cathode in electrolysis.

words.ex: Caustic potash is widely used in the production of soap and detergents.
words.ex_cn: 烧碱广泛用于肥皂和洗涤剂的生产。
words.en: Caustic potash, also known as potassium hydroxide, is a highly caustic substance used in various industrial and chemical processes.

words.ex: Caustic soda is a strong base used in many industrial processes.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种强碱，用于许多工业过程中。
words.en: Caustic soda, also known as sodium hydroxide, is a highly caustic metallic base and alkali salt.

words.tr: n. 铈（元素符号为 Ce）
words.ex: Cerium is a chemical element with the symbol Ce and atomic number 58.
words.ex_cn: 铈是一种化学元素，符号为Ce，原子序数为58。
words.en: Cerium is a soft, silvery, ductile metal which easily oxidizes in air. It is the most abundant of the rare earth elements and is found in a number of minerals, including allanite, monazite, and bastnäsite.

words.tr: n. 铯（元素符号为 Cs）
words.ex: Cesium is a soft, silvery-gold alkali metal.
words.ex_cn: 铯是一种柔软的银金色碱金属。
words.en: A soft, silvery, highly reactive metallic element of the alkali metal group, used in atomic clocks and certain types of photoelectric cells.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. 层叠样式表（Cascading Style Sheets）
words.ex: CSS is used to control the layout and design of web pages.
words.ex_cn: CSS 用于控制网页的布局和设计。
words.en: Cascading Style Sheets; a stylesheet language used to describe the presentation of a document written in HTML or XML.

words.ex: Chalcopyrite is a common copper iron sulfide mineral.
words.ex_cn: 黄铜矿是一种常见的铜铁硫化物矿物。
words.en: A yellow crystalline mineral consisting of a sulfide of copper and iron, typically occurring as tetrahedral crystals.

words.ex: The ship's hull suffered severe chemical corrosion due to long-term exposure to seawater.
words.ex_cn: 由于长期暴露在海水中，船体遭受了严重的化学腐蚀。
words.en: The process by which a material, usually a metal, is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction with its environment.

words.ex: The battery stores chemical energy which is converted into electrical energy when needed.
words.ex_cn: 电池储存的化学能在需要时转化为电能。
words.en: Energy stored in the bonds of chemical compounds, which is released during a chemical reaction.

words.ex: In a closed system, a reaction will eventually reach chemical equilibrium.
words.ex_cn: 在一个封闭的系统中，反应最终会达到化学平衡。
words.en: A state in which the concentrations of the reactants and products have no net change over time in a chemical reaction.

words.ex: The process of chemistry equalization is crucial in understanding chemical reactions.
words.ex_cn: 化学平衡的过程对于理解化学反应至关重要。
words.en: The process of adjusting the pH or chemical composition of a solution to achieve a desired equilibrium or balance.

words.tr: phrase. 化学方程式；用化学式表示化学反应中反应物和生成物之间关系的式子
words.ex: A chemical equation represents the transformation of reactants into products.
words.ex_cn: 化学方程式表示反应物转化为生成物的过程。
words.en: A chemical equation is a written representation of the process that occurs in a chemical reaction, in which the reactants are given on the left-hand side and the products on the right-hand side.

words.tr: phrase. 化学式；化学分子式，表示化合物中各元素原子种类和数量的表达式
words.ex: The chemical formula for water is H2O.
words.ex_cn: 水的化学式是 H2O。
words.en: A chemical formula is a way of presenting information about the chemical proportions of atoms that constitute a particular chemical compound or molecule, using element symbols and numbers.

words.ex: Exposure to chlorine gas can cause severe respiratory problems.
words.ex_cn: 接触氯气会导致严重的呼吸问题。
words.en: Chlorine gas is a greenish-yellow gas that is highly toxic and reactive, used in water purification and as a disinfectant.

words.ex: The pool has chlorine to keep the water clean.
words.ex_cn: 泳池里有氯来保持水的清洁。
words.en: A chemical element, a greenish-yellow gas of the halogen group, used especially in disinfection and in the manufacture of many industrial and household chemicals.

words.ex: He is cl.
words.ex_cn: 他正在cl。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cl) that is a greenish-yellow gas with a pungent odor, used in disinfectants and plastics.

words.ex: The chromogenic reaction turns the solution blue.
words.ex_cn: 显色反应使溶液变蓝。
words.en: A chromogenic reaction is a chemical process that produces a color change, often used in biochemical assays to indicate the presence of a particular substance or to measure its concentration.

words.ex: He uses cobalt in his battery project.
words.ex_cn: 他在电池项目中使用钴。
words.en: Cobalt is a hard, lustrous, silver-grey metal that is used in the production of high-strength alloys and magnets.

words.ex: Cobalt, or Co, is used in batteries.
words.ex_cn: 钴（Co）用于电池中。
words.en: prefix meaning together, jointly, or mutually, used in the formation of compound words.

words.ex: The combination reaction forms water from hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 化合反应由氢气和氧气生成水。
words.en: A combination reaction is a reaction where two or more elements or compounds combine to form a single compound.

words.ex: The engine uses combustion heat to move the car.
words.ex_cn: 发动机利用燃烧热来驱动汽车。
words.en: The heat energy released during the process of combustion.

words.ex: The condenser pipe is leaking water.
words.ex_cn: 冷凝管在漏水。
words.en: A pipe that carries condensed vapor, typically in a steam or refrigeration system, to a collection point or drain.

words.ex: He pours the liquid into a conical flask.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒入锥形瓶中。
words.en: A conical flask is a piece of laboratory glassware with a conical body and a cylindrical neck, used especially in titrations.

words.ex: The chemist drew the constitutional formula of the molecule.
words.ex_cn: 化学家画出了该分子的结构式。
words.en: The constitutional formula refers to the specific arrangement of atoms within a molecule that determines its chemical properties.

words.ex: The molecule has a coordinate bond between nitrogen and hydrogen.
words.ex_cn: 这个分子中氮和氢之间有一个配位键。
words.en: A coordinate bond is a type of chemical bond where both electrons in the shared pair are provided by a single atom.

words.ex: He used copperas to dye the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 他用绿矾来染布料。
words.en: Copperas is a green crystalline compound of iron and sulfate used in various industrial applications, including the manufacture of inks and dyes.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: He is tying his shoes quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在快速系鞋带。
words.en: Ti is a type of plant often used in decorations, especially in Hawaiian leis.

words.tr: phrase. 铜的冶炼；通过加热和化学处理从铜矿石中提取金属铜的过程
words.ex: The factory uses old machines for copper smelting.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂用旧机器进行铜冶炼。
words.en: The process of extracting copper from its ores by heating and melting.

words.tr:
v. 抵消；使平衡
n. 衡重体；平衡力
words.ex: The weight acts as a counterbalance to the arm.
words.ex_cn: 这个重量作为手臂的平衡物。
words.en: A counterbalance is a weight or force that balances or counteracts another.

words.ex: Two hydrogen atoms form a covalent bond.
words.ex_cn: 两个氢原子形成一个共价键。
words.en: A covalent bond is a chemical bond that involves the sharing of electron pairs between atoms.

words.ex: The cracking reaction breaks big molecules into smaller ones.
words.ex_cn: 裂解反应将大分子分解成小分子。
words.en: A cracking reaction is a chemical process in which large hydrocarbon molecules are broken down into smaller, more useful molecules, typically through the application of heat and pressure. This process is fundamental in the petroleum industry for the production of gasoline and other fuels.

words.tr: phrase. 坩埚；熔炼用的耐火容器，用于高温下熔化金属或进行化学反应
words.ex: The scientist poured molten metal into a crucible pot.
words.ex_cn: 科学家将熔化的金属倒入坩埚中。
words.en: A crucible pot is a container that can withstand very high temperatures and is used for metal, glass, and pigment production as well as a number of modern laboratory processes.

words.ex: New York is a melting pot of many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是多种文化的熔炉。
words.en: A place where different peoples, styles, theories, etc., are mixed together.

words.ex: The crucible melted the metal under high heat.
words.ex_cn: 坩埚在高温下熔化了金属。
words.en: A crucible is a pot in which metals or other substances are heated to a very high temperature or melted. It can also refer to a severe test or trial.

words.ex: The cryogen keeps the sample frozen.
words.ex_cn: 低温液体使样本保持冷冻。
words.en: A cryogen is a substance used to produce very low temperatures, typically for the preservation of biological materials.

words.tr: phrase. 结晶水合物；水合结晶
words.ex: The crystalline hydrate dissolved in water.
words.ex_cn: 这种水合晶体溶解在水中。
words.en: A crystalline hydrate is a compound that contains water molecules incorporated into its crystal structure.

words.ex: The gold was purified in a cupel.
words.ex_cn: 黄金在坩埚中被提纯。
words.en: A small, porous cup used in assaying to separate precious metals from base ones by melting.

words.tr: n. 锔（元素符号为 Cm）
words.ex: Curium is a radioactive element used in science.
words.ex_cn: 锔是一种用于科学的放射性元素。
words.en: Curium is a synthetic radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cm and atomic number 96. It is a transuranic element of the actinide series, named after Marie and Pierre Curie.

words.ex: Curium, or Cm, is a radioactive element used in scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 锔，符号为Cm，是一种用于科学研究的放射性元素。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.tr: phrase. 分解反应（一种化学反应，指一种化合物分解成两种或多种较简单的物质）
words.ex: The compound undergoes a decomposition reaction when heated.
words.ex_cn: 当加热时，该化合物发生分解反应。
words.en: A decomposition reaction is a type of chemical reaction where one compound breaks down into two or more simpler substances.

words.ex: The degree of ionization is low in weak acids.
words.ex_cn: 弱酸中的电离度很低。
words.en: The extent to which a substance ionizes in a solution, expressed as the ratio of the number of ions produced to the number of molecules initially present.

words.ex: The cells use a dehydration reaction to form proteins.
words.ex_cn: 细胞通过脱水反应形成蛋白质。
words.en: A chemical reaction that involves the loss of a water molecule from the reacting molecule.

words.ex: The salt showed deliquescence in the humid air.
words.ex_cn: 这种盐在潮湿的空气中发生了潮解。
words.en: The process by which a substance absorbs moisture from the air until it dissolves in the absorbed water and forms a solution.

words.ex: He will deposit the money and matter of the contract soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快会存入这笔钱并处理合同事宜。
words.en: Solid material that has settled or accumulated, often as a result of precipitation, sedimentation, or deposition.

words.ex: The doctor diose the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 医生把药给了病人。
words.en: A diose is a sugar consisting of two monosaccharide molecules linked together.

words.ex: The teacher showed a double decomposition reaction in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师在课堂上演示了一个复分解反应。
words.en: A chemical reaction in which two compounds exchange ions to form two different compounds.

words.ex: The chemist mixed two salts to make a double salt.
words.ex_cn: 化学家混合了两种盐来制成复盐。
words.en: A compound formed by the combination of two different salts which crystallize together in a definite proportion.

words.ex: He is a dropper who left school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个去年退学的留级生。
words.en: A dropper is a small tube with a hollow rubber part at one end, used for measuring out drops of liquid.

words.ex: The clothes are drying in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 衣服正在阳光下变干。
words.en: The process of removing moisture from something.

words.tr: n. 展延性；柔软性；顺从
words.ex: Gold is prized for its ductility and ability to be drawn into thin wires.
words.ex_cn: 黄金因其延展性好，能被拉成细丝而受到珍视。
words.en: Ductility is the ability of a material to be drawn or plastically deformed without fracture; it is therefore a measure of a material's ability to undergo deformation under tensile stress.

words.ex: Dysprosium is used in strong magnets.
words.ex_cn: 镝用于制造强磁铁。
words.en: Dysprosium is a chemical element with the symbol Dy and atomic number 66. It is a rare earth element with a metallic silver luster. Dysprosium is used in various applications, including in the manufacturing of data storage devices and in nuclear reactors as a control rod material.

words.ex: He dyed his hair blue last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周把头发染成了蓝色。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Dy) that is a rare earth metal, used in magnets, lasers, and nuclear reactor control rods.

words.ex: The flowers showed efflorescence in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在春天绽放。
words.en: The period or state of flowering or being in bloom; the highest point or stage in a process of development.

words.ex: Einsteinium is a rare element in science labs.
words.ex_cn: 锿是一种在科学实验室中稀有的元素。
words.en: Einsteinium is a synthetic element with the symbol Es and atomic number 99. It is a member of the actinide series and is named after the physicist Albert Einstein.

words.ex: He is studying algebra.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习代数。
words.en: A European Union (EU) country code.

words.tr: phrase. 电离；电性分离；指化合物在电场作用下分解为离子的过程或状态
words.ex: The salt shows electrical dissociation in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐在水中表现出电离。
words.en: The process by which a compound separates into ions when dissolved in a solvent, enabling the solution to conduct electricity.

words.ex: He wrote the electric formula on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把电学公式写在了黑板上。
words.en: A mathematical expression representing the relationship between electric current, voltage, and resistance.

words.ex: Salt water causes electrochemical corrosion in metal pipes.
words.ex_cn: 盐水会导致金属管道发生电化学腐蚀。
words.en: Electrochemical corrosion is a process that involves the deterioration of a material due to an electrochemical reaction with its environment.

words.ex: The electrode reaction equation shows how electrons move in the battery.
words.ex_cn: 电极反应方程式显示了电子在电池中的移动方式。
words.en: A balanced chemical equation that describes the oxidation or reduction process occurring at an electrode.

words.ex: The electrolytic reaction produces hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 电解反应产生氢气和氧气。
words.en: An electrolytic reaction is a chemical reaction that occurs when an electric current is passed through an electrolyte, causing a chemical change.

words.ex: The electron shell holds electrons around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子壳层围绕原子核容纳电子。
words.en: An electron shell is the orbit of electrons around the nucleus of an atom, which is divided into different energy levels.

words.ex: The scientist uses electrophoresis to separate DNA pieces.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用电泳来分离DNA片段。
words.en: A method used in laboratories for the separation of molecules based on their size and charge, by applying an electric field to move the molecules through a gel or other medium.

words.tr: phrase. 离子键；由正负离子之间的静电引力形成的化学键
words.ex: Salt forms an ionic bond between sodium and chlorine.
words.ex_cn: 盐在钠和氯之间形成离子键。
words.en: An ionic bond is a type of chemical bond that involves the electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions, and is the primary interaction occurring in ionic compounds.

words.ex: The chemist observed an elimination reaction in the test tube.
words.ex_cn: 化学家在试管中观察到了消除反应。
words.en: A chemical reaction in which a molecule loses atoms or groups of atoms, usually resulting in the formation of a double or triple bond.

words.ex: Erbium is used in some lasers.
words.ex_cn: 铒用于某些激光器中。
words.en: A soft, silvery metallic element of the rare earth group, used in nuclear technology and as a dopant in optical fibers.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.ex: The fruit has a sweet ester smell.
words.ex_cn: 这种水果有一种甜美的酯类气味。
words.en: An ester is a chemical compound derived from an acid (organic or inorganic) in which at least one –OH (hydroxyl) group is replaced by an –O–alkyl (alkoxy) group.

words.tr: n. 铕（元素符号为 Eu）
words.ex: Europium is used in TV screens to make red light.
words.ex_cn: 铕用于电视屏幕中产生红光。
words.en: A soft silvery-white metallic element of the lanthanide series, used in the production of fluorescent lamps and as a neutron absorber in nuclear reactors.

words.ex: Eu is a chemical element.
words.ex_cn: Eu是一种化学元素。
words.en: A European Union (EU) country code.

words.ex: He put the liquid in an evaporating dish.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒入蒸发皿中。
words.en: A shallow dish used in laboratories for the evaporation of solutions and supernatant liquids, and sometimes for ashing substances.

words.tr: phrase. 爱伦美氏瓶；锥形烧瓶
words.ex: He pours the liquid into an Erlenmeyer flask.
words.ex_cn: 他把液体倒进锥形瓶里。
words.en: A conical flask with a flat bottom and a narrow neck, used in laboratories for mixing or heating substances.

words.ex: The exothermic reaction gives off heat.
words.ex_cn: 这个放热反应释放热量。
words.en: A chemical reaction that releases energy by light or heat.

words.ex: This oil contains a lot of fatty acid.
words.ex_cn: 这种油含有大量的脂肪酸。
words.en: A fatty acid is a carboxylic acid with a long aliphatic chain, which is either saturated or unsaturated. Most naturally occurring fatty acids have an unbranched chain of an even number of carbon atoms, from 4 to 28.

words.ex: Fermium is a radioactive element used in science.
words.ex_cn: 镄是一种用于科学的放射性元素。
words.en: Fermium is a synthetic element with the symbol Fm and atomic number 100.
