words.en: A line on a map connecting points having the same temperature at a given time or on average over a given period.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: This wire has a resistance of 10 ohm.
words.ex_cn: 这条导线的电阻是10欧姆。
words.en: The ohm is the unit of electrical resistance in the International System of Units (SI). It is named after German physicist Georg Simon Ohm.

words.ex: The conductor raised his baton to start the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 指挥举起指挥棒，开始演奏交响乐。
words.en: A conductor is a person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir, or a substance that allows heat or electricity to pass through it.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: He proved the theorem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上证明了这个定理。
words.en: A theorem is a statement that has been proven on the basis of previously established statements, such as other theorems, and generally accepted statements, such as axioms.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: The radio signal suffered from interference.
words.ex_cn: 收音机信号受到了干扰。
words.en: Interference refers to the action of interfering or the process of being interfered with, especially in a context where it is unwelcome or inappropriate.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 非传导性的；电介质的
n. 电介质；绝缘体
words.ex: The glass is a good dielectric.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是一种良好的电介质。
words.en: A dielectric is a substance that does not conduct electricity, but can support an electrostatic field, and can be polarized by an applied electric field.

words.tr: n. 高度计；高度表；测高仪
words.ex: The pilot checked the altimeter before taking off.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前检查了高度计。
words.en: An instrument for determining altitude, especially an aneroid barometer used in aircraft that measures atmospheric pressure to determine height above sea level.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: The sponge reached saturation and could not hold more water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵达到饱和，再也吸不下更多水了。
words.en: Saturation is the state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed, combined with, or added.

words.tr: n. 对跖地；澳新（澳大利亚和新西兰）
words.ex: The antipodes of China is Argentina.
words.ex_cn: 中国的对跖点是阿根廷。
words.en: The antipodes are places that are on the exact opposite sides of the earth from each other.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.tr: n. 排列；排列中的任一组数字或文字
words.ex: He solved the permutation problem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上解出了这个排列问题。
words.en: A permutation is a way in which a set of things can be ordered or arranged.

words.ex: The process of vaporization is essential in many industrial applications.
words.ex_cn: 蒸发过程在许多工业应用中至关重要。
words.en: The process by which a liquid is turned into a vapor.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The elephant was gargantuan compared to the dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只大象比起狗来说巨大无比。
words.en: If you say that something is gargantuan, you are emphasizing that it is very large.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.ex: This bulb uses 60 watts.
words.ex_cn: 这个灯泡使用60瓦。
words.en: A watt is a unit of power, in the International System of Units (SI), defined as one joule per second and used to quantify the rate of energy transfer.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
n. 冠；顶部
v. 到达顶部；到达最高点
words.ex: The rooster has a bright red crest.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡有一个鲜红的冠。
words.en: The highest part of a hill or mountain; the top of a wave; a tuft or growth of feathers or skin on the head of a bird or other animal.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: The battery has a voltage of 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池的电压是9伏特。
words.en: Voltage is the electrical force measured in volts that is needed to make a current flow in a circuit.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.tr: adj. 易弯的；柔软的；动作轻盈的
words.ex: The dancer is lithe and moves gracefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者身材柔韧，动作优雅。
words.en: A person or animal that is lithe is thin, supple, and graceful.

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: The diode lets electricity flow in one direction.
words.ex_cn: 这个二极管允许电流单向流动。
words.en: A diode is a device that allows current to flow in one direction only.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: The buoyancy of the water helps the boat float.
words.ex_cn: 水的浮力帮助船漂浮。
words.en: Buoyancy is the ability of something to float in a liquid or to rise in air or gas.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: The neutron has no electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 中子不带电荷。
words.en: A neutron is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom except that of simple hydrogen. It has no electric charge and a mass slightly greater than that of a proton.

words.ex: The rocket uses chemical propulsion to fly into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用化学推进力飞入太空。
words.en: Propulsion is the force that moves something forward, especially in vehicles like cars, planes, or spacecraft.

words.tr: v. 滤；渗透；用渗滤壶煮咖啡
words.ex: Water percolates through the soil.
words.ex_cn: 水透过土壤渗出。
words.en: If a liquid percolates, it moves slowly through a substance that has very small holes in it.

words.tr: n. 冷凝器；凝结器；电容器；
words.ex: The car's air conditioning has a condenser to cool the gas.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的空调有一个冷凝器来冷却气体。
words.en: A condenser is a device or unit used to condense a substance from its gaseous to its liquid state, typically by cooling. In electronics, it refers to a device that stores electric charge.

words.ex: The amplitude of the sound is very high.
words.ex_cn: 声音的振幅非常高。
words.en: The extent or range of a quality, property, process, or phenomenon: magnitude.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: An anticyclone brings clear skies and stable weather.
words.ex_cn: 反气旋带来晴朗和稳定的天气。
words.en: An anticyclone is a large-scale circulation of winds around a central region of high atmospheric pressure, clockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and counterclockwise in the Southern Hemisphere.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: She wears a necklace made of crystal.
words.ex_cn: 她戴一条水晶制成的项链。
words.en: A crystal is a solid that has a regular, repeating arrangement of atoms. Crystals are often transparent and can be used in jewelry or as decorative objects.

words.ex: Their agreement was tenuous and easily broken.
words.ex_cn: 他们的协议很脆弱，容易破裂。
words.en: If you describe something such as a connection, a reason, or someone's position as tenuous, you mean that it is very uncertain or weak.

words.ex: The spectroscope is used to analyze the composition of light.
words.ex_cn: 分光镜用于分析光的成分。
words.en: An instrument used for the observation and analysis of spectra, especially light spectra.

words.ex: The engine produces a lot of torque.
words.ex_cn: 发动机产生很大的扭矩。
words.en: Torque is a twisting force that causes rotation.

words.tr:
v. 使波动；使起伏
adj. 波动的；起伏的
words.ex: The hills undulate gently in the distance.
words.ex_cn: 远处的山丘轻轻起伏。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a smooth, wavelike motion.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.ex: The submarine used a periscope to observe the surface.
words.ex_cn: 潜艇使用潜望镜观察水面。
words.en: A periscope is an optical instrument that allows an observer to see things that are not in the direct line of sight, typically used in submarines to see above the water surface.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.tr: v. 使正式就任；给予职位
words.ex: They inducted the new mayor with a ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过一场仪式使新市长正式就任。
words.en: To induct someone into a position or organization means to formally install them in that position or officially introduce them into that organization.

words.ex: The electromagnet pulls metal objects when it is turned on.
words.ex_cn: 当电磁铁通电时，它会吸起金属物体。
words.en: An electromagnet is a type of magnet in which the magnetic field is produced by an electric current. The magnetic field disappears when the current is turned off.

words.ex: The brightness of the sun makes it hard to look.
words.ex_cn: 阳光太亮了，很难直视。
words.en: Brightness is the quality of being bright, which can refer to the intensity of light or the quality of being intelligent or lively.

words.ex: The glass is translucent, so you can see light through it.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃是半透明的，所以你能看到光透过它。
words.en: If a material or substance is translucent, it is almost transparent, allowing some light to pass through it but not detailed shapes.

words.tr: n. 对位法；惬意（或有趣）的对比
words.ex: The composer skillfully used counterpoint to create a complex musical texture.
words.ex_cn: 作曲家巧妙地运用复调手法创造出复杂的音乐织体。
words.en: In music, counterpoint is the relationship between two or more voices that are independent in contour and rhythm, and interdependent in harmony.

words.ex: He set the timer for ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他把计时器设为十分钟。
words.en: A timer is a device that measures time intervals and signals the end of a specified period.

words.ex: The medicine comes in small granules.
words.ex_cn: 这种药是小颗粒状的。
words.en: A granule is a small compact particle of a substance.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: The sun vaporizes water from the lake.
words.ex_cn: 太阳把湖里的水蒸发了。
words.en: To convert or be converted into vapor.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: The explosion caused the annihilation of the building.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸导致了大楼的毁灭。
words.en: The complete destruction or obliteration of something.

words.ex: He uses a scanner to copy documents.
words.ex_cn: 他使用扫描仪来复制文件。
words.en: A scanner is a device that captures images from photographic prints, posters, magazine pages, and similar sources for computer editing and display.

words.tr: adj. 微温的；不冷不热的；不热情的
words.ex: He drank the tepid water slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地喝着温吞的水。
words.en: Slightly warm; lukewarm. Also, showing little enthusiasm.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: The surgeon used ether to anesthetize the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生使用乙醚使病人麻醉。
words.en: A volatile, highly flammable liquid, used in the past as an anesthetic and as a solvent.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr: adj. 反复出现的；再发生的；
words.ex: He has recurrent headaches every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都反复出现头痛。
words.en: Happening or appearing again or repeatedly.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: The solidification of the metal took place at a very high temperature.
words.ex_cn: 金属的凝固过程发生在非常高的温度下。
words.en: The process of becoming hard or solid by cooling or drying or crystallization.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: The capacitor stores electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 电容器储存电荷。
words.en: A capacitor is a device that stores electrical energy in an electric field.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: Look through the eyepiece to see the stars.
words.ex_cn: 通过目镜看星星。
words.en: The lens or group of lenses that is closest to the eye in a microscope, telescope, or other optical instrument, through which the viewer looks to see the magnified image.

words.tr: n. 螨；小虫；极小量；小家伙
words.ex: A mite is very small and lives on animals.
words.ex_cn: 螨虫非常小，生活在动物身上。
words.en: A mite is a very small creature which is related to spiders. There are many different kinds of mites, some of which can cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans.

words.ex: The clay is malleable and easy to shape.
words.ex_cn: 这种黏土是可塑的，容易塑形。
words.en: If you say that someone is malleable, you mean that they are easily influenced or controlled by other people.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.tr:
n. 抛射物；射弹；发射物；自动推进武器
adj. 发射的；射弹的；推进的
words.ex: The boy threw a projectile into the air.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把一个抛射物扔向空中。
words.en: A projectile is an object that is thrown or shot forwards, such as a bullet fired from a gun.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.tr: adj. 圆滑的；具有肥皂性质的
words.ex: He had a saponaceous manner that put everyone at ease.
words.ex_cn: 他圆滑的态度让每个人都感到轻松。
words.en: Resembling soap in texture or properties; soapy.

words.tr: v. 蒸发；排出；为人所知；发生
words.ex: Water transpires from the leaves in hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在炎热的天气中从叶子中蒸发。
words.en: If it transpires that something has happened, this previously secret or unknown fact becomes known.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.ex: Her resilience helped her recover after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她的复原力帮助她在事故后恢复。
words.en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: Protons and neutrons are examples of hadrons.
words.ex_cn: 质子和中子是强子的例子。
words.en: A hadron is a subatomic particle that is made up of quarks, held together by the strong force in the atomic nucleus.

words.ex: The slit in the curtain let in a thin beam of light.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘上的裂缝透进了一束细光。
words.en: A long, narrow cut or opening.

words.ex: The pendulum oscillate slowly.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆缓慢地摆动。
words.en: If an object oscillates, it moves repeatedly from one position to another and back again, or if a figure or value oscillates, it keeps moving up and down.

words.ex: The technician used a manometer to measure the pressure in the system.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员使用压力计测量系统中的压力。
words.en: A manometer is an instrument for measuring the pressure of a fluid or gas.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: The car's acceleration increased when the driver pressed the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当司机踩油门时，汽车的加速度增加了。
words.en: Acceleration is the rate at which a car or other vehicle can increase its speed, often measured in the time it takes to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour.

words.ex: He is learning quantum physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习量子物理。
words.en: In physics, a quantum is the minimum amount of any physical entity involved in an interaction.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: The penumbra of the eclipse was visible to the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 日食的半影可以用肉眼看到。
words.en: The partially shaded outer region of the shadow cast by an opaque object.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr: n. 重量；重物；重要性；负担；
words.ex: The weight of the box is 10 kilograms.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是10公斤。
words.en: Weight is the force with which a body is attracted toward the earth or a celestial body by gravitation and which is equal to the product of the mass and the local gravitational acceleration.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: The radio wave has a long wavelength.
words.ex_cn: 这个无线电波的波长很长。
words.en: The distance between successive crests of a wave, especially points in a sound wave or electromagnetic wave.

words.ex: The electroscope shows if an object is charged.
words.ex_cn: 验电器显示物体是否带电。
words.en: An electroscope is a device used to detect the presence of an electric charge by the movement of a lightweight object or objects within the device.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr: n. 放大；放大率；放大倍数；
words.ex: The microscope provides high magnification.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜提供高放大倍数。
words.en: Magnification is the process of making something look larger than it is, especially so that small details can be seen.

words.tr: n. 推理；推论； v. “reason”的现在分词；
words.ex: His reasoning helped solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他的推理帮助解决了这个谜题。
words.en: the process of thinking about something in a logical way in order to form a conclusion or judgment

words.ex: The prism splits sunlight into seven colors.
words.ex_cn: 棱镜将阳光分解成七种颜色。
words.en: A prism is a transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light. At least two of the flat surfaces must have an angle between them. The exact angles between the surfaces depend on the application. The traditional geometrical shape is that of a triangular prism with a triangular base and rectangular sides, and in colloquial use 'prism' usually refers to this type.

words.ex: The pig eats from the wooden trough.
words.ex_cn: 猪从木槽里吃东西。
words.en: A long, narrow open container for animals to eat or drink from; a period of low economic activity.

words.tr:
adj. 杂色的；混杂的
n. 杂色；混杂
words.ex: The motley crowd cheered at the parade.
words.ex_cn: 这群杂乱的人群在游行中欢呼。
words.en: If you describe a group of things or people as motley, you mean that they are very different from each other and do not seem to belong together.

words.tr: n. 隔热（或绝缘、隔音等的）材料（或装置）；
words.ex: Glass is a good insulator for heat.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是良好的隔热材料。
words.en: An insulator is a material or device that prevents or reduces the passage of heat, electricity, or sound.

words.ex: The ground began to subside after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨之后，地面开始下陷。
words.en: If a feeling or noise subsides, it becomes less strong or loud.

words.ex: The roots of the tree protuberate from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 树根从地面突出。
words.en: To cause to bulge or project outward.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.tr: n. 音响；声学；音响效果；
words.ex: The room has good acoustics for music.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的音响效果适合音乐。
words.en: Acoustics is the scientific study of sound, including its production, transmission, and effects.

words.ex: The reactor produces electricity for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个反应堆为城市发电。
words.en: A reactor is a device or structure in which nuclear fission or fusion reactions are initiated, controlled, and sustained.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr: n. 厌恶；嫌弃；排斥；斥力
words.ex: The sight filled her with repulsion.
words.ex_cn: 那景象让她感到厌恶。
words.en: A feeling of intense distaste or disgust.

words.ex: The ball keeps moving because of inertia.
words.ex_cn: 球因为惯性继续移动。
words.en: Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to continue moving in a straight line at a constant speed, or to stay at rest, unless it is acted upon by a force.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: The centripetal force keeps the ball moving in a circle.
words.ex_cn: 向心力使球保持圆周运动。
words.en: Moving or tending to move toward a center.

words.ex: The centrifugal force pushes the water outward.
words.ex_cn: 离心力把水向外推。
words.en: Moving or tending to move away from a center.

words.ex: The magician performed the trick of levitation.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师表演了悬浮的戏法。
words.en: Levitation is the phenomenon of a person or object being raised into the air without any physical support, often associated with magic or supernatural powers.

words.tr: n. 牵引；牵引力；拉力；拖拉；附着摩擦力
words.ex: The car lost traction on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的路面上失去了牵引力。
words.en: The action of drawing or pulling something over a surface, especially a road or track; the extent to which an idea, product, etc., gains popularity or acceptance.

words.ex: The child learns locomotion by crawling.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通过爬行学习移动。
words.en: The ability to move from place to place.

chapters.name: 专业词汇 其他物理常用术语：

words.tr: phrase. 弹簧振子；弹簧上的质量块（指经典物理中用于研究简谐运动的理想模型）
words.ex: The mass on a spring oscillates back and forth when displaced from its equilibrium position.
words.ex_cn: 弹簧上的质量在从其平衡位置移位时前后摆动。
words.en: A system in physics where a mass is attached to a spring, demonstrating simple harmonic motion and principles of oscillation.

words.ex: The absolute error is 0.5 when the real value is 10 and the measured value is 10.5.
words.ex_cn: 当真实值是10，测量值是10.5时，绝对误差是0.5。
words.en: The absolute error is the difference between the measured or inferred value of a quantity and its actual value.

words.ex: Absolute motion cannot be observed directly; it is inferred from relative motion.
words.ex_cn: 绝对运动不能直接观测到，它是从相对运动中推断出来的。
words.en: Absolute motion refers to the movement of an object in space without reference to any other object or point, considered in the context of physics and philosophy.

words.ex: Absolute temperature is measured on the Kelvin scale.
words.ex_cn: 绝对温度是用开尔文温标测量的。
words.en: Absolute temperature is a temperature scale which starts at absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature where nothing could be colder and no heat energy remains in a substance.

words.ex: The absolute temperature scale is used to measure temperatures in Kelvin.
words.ex_cn: 绝对温度标度用于以开尔文为单位测量温度。
words.en: An absolute temperature scale is a temperature scale that starts at absolute zero, the lowest possible temperature where all thermal motion of particles ceases.

words.ex: The absolute velocity of the object is measured relative to a fixed point in space.
words.ex_cn: 物体的绝对速度是相对于空间中一个固定点测量的。
words.en: Absolute velocity is the velocity of an object in a given frame of reference, measured relative to an inertial frame of reference.

words.ex: At absolute zero, all atomic motion comes to a standstill.
words.ex_cn: 在绝对零度时，所有原子运动都会停止。
words.en: The lowest temperature theoretically possible, at which the motion of particles that constitutes heat would be minimal.

words.ex: The acceleration of gravity on Earth is approximately 9.8 meters per second squared.
words.ex_cn: 地球上的重力加速度约为每秒9.8米平方。
words.en: The acceleration of gravity is the acceleration on an object caused by the force of gravitation.

words.ex: The software glitch was an accidental error, not a deliberate flaw.
words.ex_cn: 软件故障是一个意外错误，而不是故意的缺陷。
words.en: An accidental error is a mistake that occurs by chance or without intention, often in the context of experiments or measurements.

words.ex: The acting force between the two objects causes them to move closer.
words.ex_cn: n. 两个物体之间的作用力使它们靠得更近。
words.en: An acting force is a force that is applied to an object to cause it to change its velocity or shape.

words.tr: phrase. 实际功率；有效功率
words.ex: The actual power output of the generator is less than its rated capacity.
words.ex_cn: 发电机的实际功率输出小于其额定容量。
words.en: The real power that is used or produced in a system, as opposed to the theoretical or maximum power.

words.ex: He uses an air pump to inflate the bicycle tire.
words.ex_cn: 他用气泵给自行车轮胎打气。
words.en: A device for moving air or gases from one place to another, especially into or out of a confined space.

words.tr: n. 一种基于云的协作数据库应用程序，允许用户通过简单的界面创建和共享数据库。
words.ex: We use Airtable to manage our project tasks and keep track of deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用Airtable来管理我们的项目任务并跟踪截止日期。
words.en: A cloud-based platform for creating and managing databases, often used for project management and collaboration.

words.ex: The air track allows for precise measurements of motion with minimal friction.
words.ex_cn: 空气轨道能够在摩擦最小的情况下精确测量运动。
words.en: A soft, inflatable mat used in gymnastics for practicing jumps and flips, providing a safe and cushioned landing surface.

words.tr: phrase. 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（德裔美国科学家）
words.ex: Albert Einstein invented the theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦发明了相对论。
words.en: Albert Einstein was a theoretical physicist who developed the theory of relativity, one of the two pillars of modern physics (alongside quantum mechanics). His work is also known for its influence on the philosophy of science.

words.ex: The power outlet gives alternating current.
words.ex_cn: 电源插座提供交流电。
words.en: An electric current that reverses direction at regular intervals, typically used in power supplies.

words.ex: In an alternating current circuit, the direction of the current reverses periodically.
words.ex_cn: 在交流电路中，电流的方向会周期性地反转。
words.en: An alternating current circuit is an electrical circuit in which the current reverses direction periodically.

words.ex: The alternating current generator converts mechanical energy into alternating electric current.
words.ex_cn: 交流发电机将机械能转化为交流电。
words.en: A device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy in the form of alternating current.

words.tr: n. 安培计；电表；电流表
words.ex: The electrician used an ammeter to measure the current in the circuit.
words.ex_cn: 电工使用安培计来测量电路中的电流。
words.en: An ammeter is a device that measures the electric current in a circuit.

words.tr: n. 安培计； 电流表
words.ex: The technician used an amperemeter to measure the current in the circuit.
words.ex_cn: n. 技术员使用安培计测量电路中的电流。
words.en: An amperemeter is a device used to measure the electric current in a circuit, typically in amperes.

words.tr: phrase. 安培力（载流导线在磁场中受到的力，以物理学家安培命名）
words.ex: Ampere's force is the force between electric currents.
words.ex_cn: 安培力是电流之间的相互作用力。
words.en: Ampere's force refers to the force between two parallel current-carrying conductors, as described by Ampère's force law.

words.ex: Ampere's experiment showed how electric current creates a magnetic field.
words.ex_cn: 安培的实验展示了电流如何产生磁场。
words.en: An experiment by André-Marie Ampère demonstrating the magnetic effect of an electric current, foundational to electromagnetism.

words.ex: He is learning Ampere's law in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习安培定律。
words.en: Ampère's law is a fundamental law of electromagnetism that describes the magnetic field generated by an electric current.

words.tr: phrase. 安德烈-玛丽·安培（法国物理学家，电磁学的创始人之一）
words.ex: Andre-Marie Ampere was a famous scientist who studied electricity.
words.ex_cn: 安德烈-玛丽·安培是一位研究电的著名科学家。
words.en: André-Marie Ampère was a French physicist and mathematician who was one of the founders of the science of electromagnetism.

words.ex: The angle of rotation determines how much the shape has turned.
words.ex_cn: 旋转角度决定了形状转了多少。
words.en: The angle through which a point or line has been rotated in a specified sense about a specified axis.

words.ex: The angular acceleration of the wheel increased as the motor gained power.
words.ex_cn: 随着电机的功率增加，车轮的角加速度也随之增加。
words.en: Angular acceleration is the rate of change of angular velocity over time, typically measured in radians per second squared.

words.ex: The angular displacement of the wheel was measured to be 45 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的角位移被测量为45度。
words.en: Angular displacement is the angle through which a point or line has been rotated in a specified sense about a specified axis.

words.ex: The angular velocity of the wheel increased as the car sped up.
words.ex_cn: 随着汽车加速，车轮的角速度增加了。
words.en: The rate at which an object rotates around a specific axis, measured in radians per second.

words.ex: The material shows significant anisotropy in its electrical properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料在电学特性上表现出显著的各向异性。
words.en: Anisotropy is the property of being directionally dependent, as opposed to isotropy, which implies identical properties in all directions.

words.ex: According to Archimedes principle, the buoyant force on an object is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the object.
words.ex_cn: 根据阿基米德原理，物体所受的浮力等于该物体排开的流体的重量。
words.en: A principle stating that a body submerged in a fluid is buoyed up by a force equal to the weight of the displaced fluid.

words.ex: The lever's length acts as the arm of force in this mechanical advantage system.
words.ex_cn: 杠杆的长度在这个机械优势系统中充当力臂。
words.en: The perpendicular distance from the line of action of a force to the point of rotation, used in calculating torque.

words.tr: n. 散光检查器；散光计
words.ex: The optometrist used an astigmatoscope to examine the patient's eyes for refractive errors.
words.ex_cn: 验光师使用散光检查器检查患者的眼睛是否有屈光不正。
words.en: An instrument used to measure the degree of astigmatism in the eye.

words.ex: Atmospheric pressure affects weather patterns.
words.ex_cn: 大气压影响天气模式。
words.en: Atmospheric pressure is the pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of Earth (or that of another planet).

words.ex: The use of the atomic bomb in World War II marked a new era in warfare.
words.ex_cn: 二战中原子弹的使用标志着战争进入了一个新时代。
words.en: An atomic bomb is a weapon with great explosive power that results from the sudden release of energy upon the splitting, or fission, of the nuclei of a heavy element such as plutonium or uranium.

words.ex: The atomic nucleus is the central part of an atom, consisting of protons and neutrons.
words.ex_cn: 原子核是原子的中心部分，由质子和中子组成。
words.en: The central part of an atom, consisting of protons and neutrons, and containing nearly all its mass.

words.ex: Atomic physics has made significant contributions to our understanding of the universe.
words.ex_cn: 原子物理学在增进我们对宇宙的理解方面做出了重大贡献。
words.en: Atomic physics is the field of physics that studies atoms as an isolated system of electrons and an atomic nucleus.

words.ex: Atomic spectra provide valuable information about the composition of stars.
words.ex_cn: 原子光谱为研究恒星的组成提供了宝贵的信息。
words.en: The characteristic pattern of light emitted or absorbed by atoms, which can be used to identify elements and study their properties.

words.ex: The study of atomic structure has revolutionized our understanding of matter.
words.ex_cn: 对原子结构的研究彻底改变了我们对物质的理解。
words.en: The arrangement of protons, neutrons, and electrons within an atom.

words.tr: phrase. 阿特伍德机；阿特午机
words.ex: Atwood's machine is commonly used in physics classrooms to demonstrate the principles of Newtonian mechanics.
words.ex_cn: 阿特伍德机通常用于物理课堂，以演示牛顿力学的原理。
words.en: An Atwood's machine is a device used to demonstrate the principles of motion and acceleration, consisting of two masses connected by a string that passes over a pulley.

words.ex: The average power consumption of the device is 50 watts.
words.ex_cn: 该设备的平均功耗为50瓦。
words.en: The mean rate of energy transfer, work done, or heat transferred per unit time.

words.ex: The average velocity of the car was calculated to be 60 km/h.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的平均速度被计算为每小时60公里。
words.en: The average velocity is defined as the total displacement divided by the total time taken.

words.tr: phrase. 阿伏伽德罗定律：在相同温度和压力下，相同体积的任何气体含有相同数量的分子
words.ex: According to Avogadro's law, two different gases in equal volumes at the same temperature and pressure contain the same number of molecules.
words.ex_cn: 根据阿伏伽德罗定律，在相同的温度和压力下，体积相等的两种不同气体含有相同数量的分子。
words.en: Avogadro's law is a gas law which states that equal volumes of gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules.

words.ex: A ballistic galvanometer is used to measure the quantity of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 冲击电流计用于测量电量的多少。
words.en: A ballistic galvanometer is an instrument used to measure the quantity of electric charge by the impulse given to a magnetic needle.

words.tr: phrase. 谱带； 带（状）光谱
words.ex: The analysis of the band spectrum provided valuable information about the composition of the gas.
words.ex_cn: 带状光谱的分析提供了有关气体成分的宝贵信息。
words.en: A band spectrum refers to a spectrum that consists of bands of light, which are characteristic of molecular spectra.

words.ex: The basic quantity of water needed for survival is about 2 liters per day.
words.ex_cn: 生存所需的基本水量大约是每天2升。
words.en: A basic quantity is a fundamental physical quantity that is defined independently of other quantities and from which other quantities may be derived.

words.ex: The cell is the basic unit of life.
words.ex_cn: 细胞是生命的基本单位。
words.en: The fundamental or smallest part of a system or organization that can exist independently.

words.ex: He is charging his phone with a new charger.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用一个新的充电器给手机充电。
words.en: A charger is a device that is used to put electricity into a battery.

words.tr: n. 蓄电池；累加器；收集…的人
words.ex: The car battery is an accumulator.
words.ex_cn: 汽车电池是一个蓄电池。
words.en: An accumulator is a device that stores energy, typically in the form of electricity, for later use. In computing, it refers to a register in a computer processor where intermediate arithmetic and logic results are stored.

words.tr: n. 电子回旋加速器；电子感应加速器
words.ex: The betatron is used to accelerate electrons to high energies.
words.ex_cn: 电子感应加速器用于将电子加速到高能量。
words.en: A betatron is a device for accelerating electrons in a circular path by means of the electric field produced by a varying magnetic field.

words.ex: The Bohr atom model was a groundbreaking theory in the early 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 玻尔原子模型是20世纪初的一项突破性理论。
words.en: The Bohr atom model is a theory of atomic structure introduced by Niels Bohr in 1913. It depicts the atom as a small, positively charged nucleus surrounded by electrons that travel in circular orbits around the nucleus—similar to the structure of the Solar System, but with attraction provided by electrostatic forces rather than gravity.

words.tr: phrase. 沸点；（局势的）爆发点；情绪激昂
words.ex: Water reaches its boiling point at 100°C under standard atmospheric pressure.
words.ex_cn: 在标准大气压下，水在100°C时达到沸点。
words.en: The temperature at which a liquid boils and turns to vapor under a given pressure.

words.ex: The bound charge creates an internal electric field that opposes the external field.
words.ex_cn: 束缚电荷产生了一个与外部电场相反的内部电场。
words.en: A bound charge is an electric charge that is bound to an atom or molecule within a material, as opposed to a free charge which can move freely within the material.

words.ex: The energy levels of bound electrons are quantized.
words.ex_cn: 束缚电子的能级是量子化的。
words.en: An electron that is attached to an atom and not free to move.

words.tr: phrase. 玻意耳定律（在恒定温度下，理想气体的压强与体积成反比）
words.ex: Boyle's law states that the volume of a gas is inversely proportional to its pressure at a constant temperature.
words.ex_cn: 波义耳定律指出，在恒温下，气体的体积与其压力成反比。
words.en: Boyle's law is a principle in physics that describes how the pressure of a gas tends to increase as the volume of the container decreases, provided the temperature remains constant.

words.ex: The phenomenon of Brownian motion can be observed under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 布朗运动现象在显微镜下可以观察到。
words.en: Brownian motion is the random motion of particles suspended in a fluid (a liquid or a gas) resulting from their collision with the quick atoms or molecules in the gas or liquid.

words.ex: The buoyancy force allows the boat to float on water.
words.ex_cn: n. 浮力让船能在水上漂浮。
words.en: The upward force exerted by a fluid that opposes the weight of an immersed object.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The capacitor has a high capacitance.
words.ex_cn: 这个电容器的电容很高。
words.en: Capacitance is the ability of a system to store an electric charge.

words.tr: n. 毛细管作用；毛细管现象
words.ex: The phenomenon of capillarity allows water to rise in narrow tubes.
words.ex_cn: 毛细管现象使水能够在细管中上升。
words.en: Capillarity is the ability of a liquid to flow in narrow spaces without the assistance of external forces (like gravity).

words.ex: The cathode ray tube is used in older television sets.
words.ex_cn: 阴极射线管用于老式电视机。
words.en: A cathode ray is a stream of electrons observed in vacuum tubes. It was the first evidence of the existence of electrons and led to the development of the field of electronics.

words.ex: The cathode-ray tube was commonly used in older television sets.
words.ex_cn: 阴极射线管在老式电视机中很常见。
words.en: A cathode-ray tube is a vacuum tube containing one or more electron guns, the beams of which are manipulated to display images on a phosphorescent screen.

words.ex: The car won't start because the cell battery is dead.
words.ex_cn: 汽车无法启动，因为电池没电了。
words.en: A small, portable device that stores and provides electrical energy, typically used in electronic devices.

words.ex: The Celsius scale is widely used in scientific and everyday contexts.
words.ex_cn: 摄氏温标在科学和日常生活中被广泛使用。
words.en: The Celsius scale is a temperature scale where 0 degrees is the freezing point of water and 100 degrees is the boiling point of water at sea level.

words.ex: The center of gravity is crucial for the stability of the structure.
words.ex_cn: 重心对于结构的稳定性至关重要。
words.en: The point in a body or system around which its mass or weight is evenly distributed or balanced and through which the force of gravity acts.

words.ex: The center of mass of the system is located at the midpoint between the two objects.
words.ex_cn: 系统的质心位于两个物体之间的中点。
words.en: The center of mass is a point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.

words.ex: The centrifugal force pushes the water out of the clothes in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 离心力把水从衣服上甩出去。
words.en: A force that acts on a body moving in a circular path and is directed away from the center around which the body is moving.

words.ex: The centripetal acceleration is the acceleration towards the center of the circular path.
words.ex_cn: 向心加速度是朝向圆周路径中心点的加速度。
words.en: The acceleration of an object moving in a circular path, directed towards the center around which the object is moving.

words.ex: The centripetal force keeps the ball from flying off the string.
words.ex_cn: 向心力使球不会从绳子上飞出去。
words.en: A force that acts on a body moving in a circular path and is directed toward the center around which the body is moving.

words.ex: A small spark caused a chain reaction in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 一个小火花在实验室引发了连锁反应。
words.en: A chain reaction is a series of events, each caused by the previous one.

words.ex: The characteristic spectrum of a star can reveal its composition.
words.ex_cn: 恒星的特征光谱可以揭示其成分。
words.en: A characteristic spectrum refers to the unique pattern of wavelengths or frequencies of light emitted or absorbed by a particular substance, which can be used to identify the substance.

words.tr: phrase. 查理定律（气体体积与绝对温度成正比的定律）
words.ex: According to Charles's law, the volume of a gas increases as the temperature increases.
words.ex_cn: 根据查尔斯定律，气体的体积随着温度的升高而增加。
words.en: Charles's law is a gas law which states that the volume of a given mass of gas varies directly with the absolute temperature of the gas when pressure is kept constant.

words.ex: The charged body attracted small pieces of paper.
words.ex_cn: 带电体吸引了小纸片。
words.en: A charged body refers to an object that carries an electric charge, either positive or negative, which can interact with other charged objects or electric fields.

words.ex: In the experiment, we observed the behavior of charged particles in a magnetic field.
words.ex_cn: 在实验中，我们观察了带电粒子在磁场中的行为。
words.en: A charged particle is a particle with an electric charge, which can be either positive or negative. Charged particles are fundamental to the structure of matter and play a crucial role in various physical phenomena.

words.tr: phrase. 查利·奥古斯丁·库仑
words.ex: Charles Augustin de Coulomb's work laid the foundation for the study of electromagnetism.
words.ex_cn: 查尔斯·奥古斯丁·库仑的工作为电磁学的研究奠定了基础。
words.en: Charles Augustin de Coulomb was a French physicist who is best known for developing Coulomb's law, the description of the electrostatic force of attraction and repulsion.

words.tr: phrase. 克里斯蒂安·惠更斯
words.ex: Christian Huygens was a pioneer in the field of optics and developed the first accurate pendulum clock.
words.ex_cn: 克里斯蒂安·惠更斯是光学领域的先驱，并发明了第一个精确的摆钟。
words.en: Christian Huygens was a prominent Dutch physicist, astronomer, and mathematician, best known for his contributions to the wave theory of light.

words.ex: The technician studied the circuit diagram to identify the problem.
words.ex_cn: 技术员研究了电路图以识别问题。
words.en: A circuit diagram is a graphical representation of an electrical circuit. It shows the components of the circuit as simplified standard symbols, and the power and signal connections between the devices.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrated the principle of circular hole diffraction.
words.ex_cn: n. 这个实验展示了圆孔衍射的原理。
words.en: The phenomenon where light waves spread out after passing through a small circular aperture, leading to a pattern of interference and diffraction.

words.ex: The Earth's circular motion around the Sun takes approximately 365 days.
words.ex_cn: 地球绕太阳的圆周运动大约需要365天。
words.en: Circular motion refers to the movement of an object along the circumference of a circle or rotation along a circular path.

words.ex: Classical mechanics provides a framework for understanding the motion of objects under the influence of forces.
words.ex_cn: 经典力学提供了一个理解物体在力作用下运动的框架。
words.en: Classical mechanics is a branch of physics that deals with the motion of bodies under the influence of forces, especially those that are not moving at speeds close to the speed of light.

words.ex: Classical physics was unable to explain the photoelectric effect.
words.ex_cn: n. 经典物理学无法解释光电效应。
words.en: Classical physics refers to the theories of physics that predate modern, more complete, or more widely applicable theories, especially those developed before the advent of quantum mechanics and relativity.

words.ex: The security system uses a closed circuit television.
words.ex_cn: 安全系统使用闭路电视。
words.en: A closed circuit is a complete electrical circuit around which current flows or a signal circulates. In the context of television, it refers to a system in which the signal is transmitted by cable to a limited set of monitors.

words.ex: The cloud chamber is used to observe the tracks of particles.
words.ex_cn: 云室用于观察粒子的轨迹。
words.en: A cloud chamber is a device used for detecting ionizing radiation and observing the tracks of charged particles.

words.ex: The coefficient of maximum static friction is a crucial factor in determining the stability of objects on inclined surfaces.
words.ex_cn: 最大静摩擦系数是确定物体在倾斜表面上稳定性的关键因素。
words.en: The coefficient of maximum static friction is a dimensionless scalar value which describes the ratio of the maximum static friction force between two surfaces to the normal force pressing them together.

words.tr: phrase. 回弹系数；恢复系数
words.ex: The coefficient of restitution is a measure of the elasticity of the collision.
words.ex_cn: 恢复系数是衡量碰撞弹性的一个指标。
words.en: The coefficient of restitution is a measure of the elasticity of collisions, indicating how much kinetic energy remains after a collision.

words.ex: The coefficient of sliding friction is a measure of how much force is needed to maintain a constant velocity over a surface.
words.ex_cn: 滑动摩擦系数是衡量在表面上保持恒定速度所需力的大小的量度。
words.en: The coefficient of sliding friction is a dimensionless scalar value which describes the ratio of the force of friction between two bodies and the force pressing them together.

words.tr: phrase. 刚度系数；劲度系数
words.ex: The coefficient of stiffness is a measure of how much a material resists deformation.
words.ex_cn: 劲度系数是衡量材料抵抗变形能力的量度。
words.en: The coefficient of stiffness is a measure of the resistance of a body to deformation in response to an applied force.

words.ex: Laser technology relies on the use of coherent light to produce precise and focused beams.
words.ex_cn: 激光技术依赖于使用相干光来产生精确和集中的光束。
words.en: Coherent light refers to light waves that are in phase both spatially and temporally, allowing them to interfere constructively and destructively.

words.ex: A coherent wave source is essential for interference experiments.
words.ex_cn: 相干波源对于干涉实验是必不可少的。
words.en: A coherent wave source is a source that emits waves with a constant phase difference, which is essential for the production of interference patterns.

words.ex: In laser technology, coherent waves are used to produce a highly focused beam.
words.ex_cn: 在激光技术中，相干波被用来产生高度聚焦的光束。
words.en: A wave that maintains a constant phase relationship in both time and space, allowing for constructive and destructive interference.

words.ex: The component velocity in the x-direction is crucial for calculating the overall trajectory.
words.ex_cn: x方向上的分速度对于计算整体轨迹至关重要。
words.en: The velocity of a component in a particular direction, especially in physics or engineering contexts.

words.ex: The composition of forces is a fundamental concept in physics.
words.ex_cn: 力的合成是物理学中的一个基本概念。
words.en: The process of determining a single force that has the same effect as two or more forces acting together.

words.ex: The composition of velocities is a fundamental concept in physics.
words.ex_cn: 速度的合成是物理学中的一个基本概念。
words.en: The principle that describes how velocities add together in physics, especially in the context of classical mechanics and relativity.

words.ex: The concave lens makes things look smaller.
words.ex_cn: 凹透镜使物体看起来更小。
words.en: A concave lens is a lens that possesses at least one surface that curves inwards. It is thinner at the center than at the edges and is used to diverge light rays.

words.ex: The concave mirror in the telescope helps to focus the light.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜中的凹面镜有助于聚焦光线。
words.en: A concave mirror is a mirror that curves inward, like the inside of a bowl. It is used to focus light to a single point, making it useful in telescopes, headlights, and other devices that require light to be concentrated.

words.ex: The analysis of concurrent forces is crucial in engineering mechanics.
words.ex_cn: 共点力的分析在工程力学中至关重要。
words.en: A concurrent force refers to forces that act on the same point at the same time.

words.ex: The conducting medium in the circuit is a copper wire.
words.ex_cn: 电路中的导电介质是铜线。
words.en: A material or substance that allows the flow of electrical charge or heat.

words.ex: Gravity is a well-known example of a conservative force.
words.ex_cn: 重力是众所周知的保守力的一个例子。
words.en: A conservative force is a force with the property that the total work done in moving a particle between two points is independent of the taken path.

words.ex: In a conservative force field, the work done by the force is path-independent.
words.ex_cn: 在保守力场中，力所做的功与路径无关。
words.en: A conservative force field is a vector field representing the force experienced by a particle at any point in space, where the work done moving the particle between two points is independent of the path taken.

words.ex: The circuit is designed to maintain a constant current.
words.ex_cn: 该电路设计用于维持恒定电流。
words.en: A constant current is an electric current that does not vary with time.

words.ex: The constant force applied to the object caused it to accelerate uniformly.
words.ex_cn: 施加在物体上的恒力使其均匀加速。
words.en: A constant force is a force that remains unchanged in magnitude and direction over time.

words.ex: The continuous spectrum of light is observed when a white light is passed through a prism.
words.ex_cn: 当白光通过棱镜时，可以观察到光的连续谱。
words.en: A continuous spectrum is a spectrum in which the radiation is distributed over all frequencies, not just specific wavelengths.

words.ex: The control variable method is widely used in scientific research to isolate the effect of one variable on another.
words.ex_cn: 控制变量法广泛应用于科学研究中，以隔离一个变量对另一个变量的影响。
words.en: A scientific method used in experiments to isolate the effect of one variable by keeping other variables constant.

words.ex: A convergent lens is used to focus light into a single point.
words.ex_cn: 会聚透镜用于将光线聚焦到一点。
words.en: A lens that causes light rays to converge to a single point.

words.ex: The magnifying glass uses a convex lens.
words.ex_cn: 放大镜使用了一个凸透镜。
words.en: A convex lens is a lens that is thicker in the middle than at the edges, causing light rays to converge.

words.ex: The convex mirror at the intersection helped drivers see around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 交叉路口的凸面镜帮助司机看到拐角处的情况。
words.en: A convex mirror is a curved mirror in which the reflective surface bulges towards the light source. Convex mirrors reflect light outwards, therefore they are not used to focus light. Such mirrors always form a virtual image, since the focal point (F) and the centre of curvature (2F) are both imaginary points 'inside' the mirror, that cannot be reached. As a result, images formed by these mirrors cannot be projected on a screen, since the image is inside the mirror. The image is smaller than the object, but gets larger as the object approaches the mirror.

words.ex: In statics, coplanar forces are analyzed to determine their resultant.
words.ex_cn: 在静力学中，共面力被分析以确定其合力。
words.en: A coplanar force is a force that lies in the same plane as other forces being considered, often used in the context of engineering mechanics to analyze systems where all forces act within a single plane.

words.tr: phrase. 科里奥利力；地球自转偏向力
words.ex: The Coriolis force causes the wind to deflect to the right in the Northern Hemisphere.
words.ex_cn: 科里奥利力使北半球的气流向右偏转。
words.en: The Coriolis force is an inertial force that acts on objects that are in motion within a frame of reference that rotates with respect to an inertial frame. In a reference frame with clockwise rotation, the force acts to the left of the motion of the object; in one with counter-clockwise rotation, the force acts to the right.

words.tr: phrase. 科里奥利定理；科氏定理
words.ex: The Coriolis theorem is used to describe the motion of objects in rotating systems.
words.ex_cn: 科里奥利定理用于描述旋转系统中物体的运动。
words.en: The Coriolis theorem is a principle in physics that describes the effect of the Earth's rotation on the movement of objects over the Earth's surface, causing them to veer to the right in the Northern Hemisphere and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The corpuscular property of light was a significant discovery in the field of physics.
words.ex_cn: 光的微粒性是物理学领域的一个重要发现。
words.en: The characteristic of being composed of or resembling corpuscles; the particulate nature of matter.

words.tr: phrase. 微粒说；微粒子理论
words.ex: The corpuscular theory was an early attempt to explain the nature of light.
words.ex_cn: 微粒说是早期尝试解释光性质的理论。
words.en: The corpuscular theory is a theory that light is made up of small discrete particles called 'corpuscles' (little particles) which travel in straight lines with a finite velocity and possess kinetic energy.

words.ex: The Coulomb force is responsible for the attraction and repulsion between charged particles.
words.ex_cn: 库仑力是带电粒子间吸引和排斥的原因。
words.en: The Coulomb force is the force of attraction or repulsion between two charged particles. It is named after Charles-Augustin de Coulomb, who first described it.

words.ex: Coulomb's law describes the electrostatic force between two charged particles.
words.ex_cn: 库仑定律描述了两个带电粒子之间的静电力。
words.en: Coulomb's law is a principle of physics that describes the force between two charged particles. It states that the force is directly proportional to the product of their charges and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.

words.ex: The creepage of the metal under high temperature was observed.
words.ex_cn: 观察到金属在高温下的蠕变。
words.en: The slow movement or progress of something, especially something that is not easily noticed.

words.ex: The light reflects at the critical angle.
words.ex_cn: 光在临界角处反射。
words.en: The critical angle is the angle of incidence beyond which rays of light passing through a denser medium to the surface of a less dense medium are no longer refracted but totally reflected.

words.ex: The design of the circuit must consider the critical resistance to ensure proper operation.
words.ex_cn: 电路的设计必须考虑临界电阻以确保正常运行。
words.en: The minimum resistance required for a circuit or component to function properly or safely under specific conditions.

words.ex: The critical temperature of water is 374°C, above which it becomes a supercritical fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水的临界温度是374°C，高于这个温度它就会变成超临界流体。
words.en: The critical temperature of a substance is the highest temperature at which the substance can exist as a liquid, regardless of the pressure applied.

words.tr: phrase. 电流密度； 扩散[弥漫]流密度
words.ex: The current density is a measure of how much electric current is flowing through a given area.
words.ex_cn: 电流密度是衡量通过给定面积的电流量多少的量度。
words.en: Current density is a measure of the electric current (flow of electric charge) per unit area of cross section.

words.ex: The current element is hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的元件是热的。
words.en: A source of electrical energy, such as a battery or generator, that produces a continuous flow of electric charge.

words.ex: The circuit uses a current source to power the LED.
words.ex_cn: 这个电路使用电流源来为LED供电。
words.en: A device or circuit that provides a constant flow of electric current, regardless of the voltage across it.

words.ex: The current strength of the river is too strong for swimming.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的水流强度太大，不适合游泳。
words.en: The intensity of an electric current in a circuit, measured in amperes.

words.ex: The car shows curvilinear motion on the winding road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在蜿蜒的道路上做曲线运动。
words.en: Curvilinear motion refers to the movement of an object along a curved path.

words.ex: Scientists use a cyclotron to accelerate particles.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用回旋加速器来加速粒子。
words.en: A cyclotron is a type of particle accelerator that uses a constant magnetic field and alternating electric fields to accelerate charged particles in a spiral path.

words.tr: phrase. 衰减振动；阻尼振动
words.ex: The bridge shows damped vibration after the wind stops.
words.ex_cn: 风停后，桥梁的振动逐渐减弱。
words.en: A type of oscillation that loses energy over time, typically due to friction or resistance, resulting in a gradual decrease in amplitude.

words.tr: n. 阻尼； v. “damp”的现在分词；
words.ex: The car's damping system makes the ride smoother.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的阻尼系统使行驶更平稳。
words.en: Damping refers to the effect of reducing the amplitude of oscillations or vibrations in a system, often to prevent excessive movement or to bring the system to rest.

words.ex: The daniell cell produces electricity using zinc and copper.
words.ex_cn: 丹尼尔电池使用锌和铜产生电能。
words.en: A Daniell cell is a type of electrochemical cell invented in 1836 by John Frederic Daniell, consisting of a copper pot filled with a copper(II) sulfate solution, in which is immersed an unglazed earthenware container filled with sulfuric acid and a zinc electrode.

words.ex: Speed is a derived quantity from distance and time.
words.ex_cn: 速度是由距离和时间导出的量。
words.en: A derived quantity is a quantity that is calculated from one or more base quantities in a system of measurement.

words.ex: The speed is a derived unit from meter and second.
words.ex_cn: 速度是由米和秒导出的单位。
words.en: A derived unit is a unit of measurement obtained by combining base units according to the rules of the system.

words.tr: n. 衍射；绕射；光的衍射；
words.ex: Light shows diffraction when it passes through a narrow slit.
words.ex_cn: 光通过窄缝时会发生衍射。
words.en: Diffraction is the process by which a beam of light or other system of waves is spread out as a result of passing through a narrow aperture or across an edge.

words.ex: The light creates a diffraction pattern on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 光在墙上形成衍射图样。
words.en: A diffraction pattern is the interference pattern that results when a wavefront is diffracted by an aperture or a grating.

words.ex: The wall shows diffuse reflection under the lamp.
words.ex_cn: 墙在灯下发生漫反射。
words.en: The process by which light or other waves or particles are scattered in many directions by a surface, rather than being reflected in a single direction.

words.ex: He set the digital timer for ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他把数字计时器设为十分钟。
words.en: A digital timer is a device that counts down from a specified time interval, used to measure time in a digital format.

words.ex: The dimensional exponent is two in area calculations.
words.ex_cn: 在面积计算中，量纲指数是二。
words.en: The exponent in a dimensional formula that indicates how a physical quantity scales with changes in fundamental units.

words.ex: He wears glasses with a +2.0 diopter lens.
words.ex_cn: 他戴的眼镜度数是+2.0屈光度。
words.en: A unit of measurement of the refractive power of a lens or an eye, equal to the reciprocal of the focal length measured in meters.

words.ex: The battery produces direct current.
words.ex_cn: 电池产生直流电。
words.en: Direct current (DC) is the unidirectional flow of electric charge.

words.tr: abbr. 直流电；“direct current”的缩写
words.ex: He uses dc power for his small device.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的小设备使用直流电。
words.en: Abbreviation for direct current, a type of electric current that flows consistently in one direction.

words.ex: The ball had a direct impact with the wall.
words.ex_cn: 球直接撞上了墙。
words.en: A direct impact is an immediate effect or influence that something has on a situation or person.

words.ex: He uses a ruler for direct measurement of the length.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子直接测量长度。
words.en: The process of obtaining data or values directly from a source without intermediate calculations or estimations.

words.ex: The dispersion of the students made the classroom quiet.
words.ex_cn: 学生的分散使教室安静了。
words.en: Dispersion refers to the process or state of being distributed or spread over a wide area, or the separation of light into different colors.

words.ex: The divergent lens makes objects look smaller.
words.ex_cn: 发散透镜使物体看起来更小。
words.en: A lens that causes light rays to spread out (diverge) as though emanating from a point, used to correct for nearsightedness or to create virtual images.

words.ex: The pitch of the siren changes because of the doppler effect.
words.ex_cn: 警报器的音调因多普勒效应而改变。
words.en: The change in frequency or wavelength of a wave in relation to an observer who is moving relative to the wave source.

words.ex: The light shows double slit diffraction on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 光在屏幕上显示出双缝衍射。
words.en: A phenomenon that occurs when waves pass through two closely spaced slits, leading to an interference pattern that demonstrates the wave nature of light.

words.ex: Passion is the driving force behind her success.
words.ex_cn: 热情是她成功的驱动力。
words.en: A driving force is a person or thing that has a very powerful effect on what happens or on how people behave.

words.ex: The remote uses a dry cell battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用干电池。
words.en: A dry cell is a type of electric battery, commonly used in portable electrical devices. It is called 'dry' because it uses a paste electrolyte, with just enough moisture to allow current to flow.

words.tr: phrase. 地球的磁场，指地球周围存在的磁力场，它保护地球免受太阳风和宇宙射线的侵害
words.ex: The compass points to the earth's magnetic field.
words.ex_cn: 指南针指向地球的磁场。
words.en: The magnetic field that extends from the Earth's interior out into space, where it interacts with the solar wind, a stream of charged particles emanating from the Sun.

words.ex: The metal detector uses eddy current to find hidden objects.
words.ex_cn: 金属探测器利用涡流来寻找隐藏的物体。
words.en: An eddy current is a current of electricity that is induced in a conductor by a changing magnetic field, and that flows in a circular path within the conductor.

words.ex: The effective value of the voltage is 220 volts.
words.ex_cn: 电压的有效值是220伏特。
words.en: The effective value is the value of an alternating current or voltage that would produce the same power dissipation in a resistive load as a direct current or voltage of the same magnitude.

words.ex: The virtual value is not real but useful.
words.ex_cn: 虚拟值不是真实的，但很有用。
words.en: A calculated or estimated value that represents a quantity in a theoretical or simulated context, not a direct physical measurement.

words.ex: The elastic body stretches when you pull it.
words.ex_cn: 当你拉它时，这个有弹性的身体会伸展。
words.en: An elastic body is a material that returns to its original shape after being deformed by an external force.

words.ex: The rubber band shows elastic deformation when you pull it.
words.ex_cn: 当你拉橡皮筋时，它会表现出弹性变形。
words.en: Elastic deformation refers to the temporary change in shape or size of a material under stress, which is reversible upon the removal of the stress.

words.ex: The rubber band stores elastic energy when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时储存弹性势能。
words.en: Elastic energy is the potential mechanical energy stored in the configuration of a material or physical system as work is performed to distort its volume or shape.

words.ex: The spring shows elastic force when you pull it.
words.ex_cn: 当你拉弹簧时，它会表现出弹力。
words.en: Elastic force is the force exerted by a material when it is stretched or compressed, returning to its original shape.

words.ex: The balloon has an electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 气球带有静电荷。
words.en: Electric charge is the physical property of matter that causes it to experience a force when placed in an electromagnetic field.

words.ex: The boy fixed the electric circuit with a wire.
words.ex_cn: 男孩用一根电线修好了电路。
words.en: An electric circuit is a path in which electrons from a voltage or current source flow.

words.ex: The electric corona glows around the high-voltage wire.
words.ex_cn: 高压电线周围有电晕发光。
words.en: An electric corona is a luminous discharge of electricity that appears around a conductor when the voltage exceeds a certain threshold, often visible as a faint glow in the dark.

words.ex: The wire carries an electric current.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线传输电流。
words.en: An electric current is a flow of electric charge. In electric circuits this charge is often carried by moving electrons in a wire.

words.ex: The lamp uses electric energy to light up.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯使用电能来发光。
words.en: Electric energy is a form of energy resulting from the flow of electric charge. It is one of the most widely used forms of energy in the modern world, powering everything from household appliances to industrial machinery.

words.ex: The electric field pushes the charged particle.
words.ex_cn: 电场推动带电粒子。
words.en: An electric field is a region around a charged particle or object within which a force would be exerted on other charged particles or objects.

words.ex: The electric field intensity is strong near the wire.
words.ex_cn: 电线附近的电场强度很强。
words.en: Electric field intensity is a vector quantity that represents the force per unit charge exerted on a positive test charge placed in the field.

words.ex: The electric field line shows the direction of the force.
words.ex_cn: 电场线显示了力的方向。
words.en: A line of force in an electric field, representing the direction a positive charge would move.

words.ex: The electric flux through the surface is zero.
words.ex_cn: 通过这个表面的电通量为零。
words.en: Electric flux is a measure of the number of electric field lines passing through a given area. It is a concept used in the field of electromagnetism to quantify the electric field's effect over a surface.

words.ex: The old wire causes electric leakage.
words.ex_cn: 这根旧电线导致漏电。
words.en: Electric leakage refers to the escape of electric current from its intended path, which can pose safety hazards.

words.ex: The atom has electric neutrality because its protons and electrons are equal.
words.ex_cn: 原子具有电中性，因为它的质子和电子数量相等。
words.en: The state of being electrically neutral, where the total positive charge equals the total negative charge.

words.ex: The battery creates a high electric potential.
words.ex_cn: 电池产生高的电势。
words.en: Electric potential is the amount of electric potential energy that a unitary point electric charge would have if located at any point in space, and is equal to the work done by an external agent in carrying a unit positive charge from an arbitrarily chosen reference point to that point without any acceleration.

words.ex: The battery creates an electric potential difference between its terminals.
words.ex_cn: 电池在其端子之间产生电势差。
words.en: The difference in electric potential between two points in a circuit, which is the work needed per unit of charge to move a test charge between the two points.

words.ex: The ball has high electric potential energy near the positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 这个球在正电荷附近具有很高的电势能。
words.en: Electric potential energy is the energy that is stored in an object due to its position in an electric field.

words.ex: The town uses solar panels to generate electric power.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用太阳能板来发电。
words.en: Electric power is the rate at which electrical energy is transferred by an electric circuit.

words.ex: The electric quantity in the wire is very small.
words.ex_cn: 导线中的电量非常小。
words.en: A measurable physical property related to electricity, such as charge, voltage, current, or resistance.

words.ex: He does electric work for houses.
words.ex_cn: 他为房屋做电工工作。
words.en: Electric work refers to the field of engineering that deals with the study and application of electricity, electronics, and electromagnetism.

words.ex: The lab uses simple electrical apparatus for experiments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室用简单的电气设备进行实验。
words.en: Electrical apparatus refers to devices or equipment that operate using electricity, designed for specific electrical functions or tasks.

words.ex: The balloon becomes charged by electrification by friction.
words.ex_cn: 气球通过摩擦起电而带电。
words.en: Electrification by friction refers to the process of generating static electricity by rubbing two different materials together, causing electrons to transfer from one material to the other.

words.ex: The electrified body shocked the man.
words.ex_cn: 带电的身体电到了那个人。
words.en: An electrified body refers to an object that has been charged with electricity, either positively or negatively, and thus exhibits electrical properties.

words.ex: The magnet causes electromagnetic damping in the moving coil.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁使运动的线圈产生电磁阻尼。
words.en: Electromagnetic damping refers to the process of reducing oscillations or vibrations in a system through the use of electromagnetic forces.

words.ex: The magnet creates an electromagnetic field around it.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁在它周围产生一个电磁场。
