words.ex: The relative humidity is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的相对湿度很高。
words.en: Relative humidity is the amount of water vapor present in air expressed as a percentage of the amount needed for saturation at the same temperature.

words.ex: The resistivity of the material is crucial in determining its suitability for electrical applications.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料的电阻率对其在电气应用中的适用性至关重要。
words.en: Resistivity is a measure of the resistance of a material to the flow of electric current.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: The resultant force acting on the object caused it to accelerate.
words.ex_cn: 作用在物体上的合力使其加速。
words.en: The single force which has the same effect as two or more forces acting together.

words.ex: The net force acting on the object is zero, so it remains stationary.
words.ex_cn: 作用在物体上的合力为零，因此它保持静止。
words.en: The vector sum of all the forces acting on an object.

words.ex: The right-hand rule is used to determine the direction of the magnetic field around a current-carrying wire.
words.ex_cn: 右手定则用于确定电流通过导线时磁场的方向。
words.en: A mnemonic used to determine the direction of the magnetic force, magnetic field, or current in electromagnetism.

words.ex: The rotational axis of the Earth is tilted at an angle of 23.5 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 地球的自转轴倾斜了23.5度。
words.en: The rotational axis is an imaginary line around which an object rotates.

words.ex: Rutherford's Model revolutionized the understanding of atomic structure.
words.ex_cn: 卢瑟福模型彻底改变了人们对原子结构的理解。
words.en: Rutherford's model refers to the atomic model proposed by Ernest Rutherford, which describes the atom as having a small, dense, positively charged nucleus surrounded by orbiting electrons.

words.ex: In physics, a scalar field is often used to describe temperature distribution.
words.ex_cn: 在物理学中，标量场常用于描述温度分布。
words.en: A scalar field is a function that assigns a scalar value to every point in a space.

words.ex: The second cosmic velocity is the speed needed to escape the gravitational pull of a celestial body.
words.ex_cn: 第二宇宙速度是逃逸天体引力所需的速度。
words.en: The minimum speed needed for an object to break free from a planet's gravitational attraction without further propulsion.

words.ex: The selective absorption of certain wavelengths of light gives the sky its blue color.
words.ex_cn: 某些波长的光被选择性吸收，使得天空呈现蓝色。
words.en: The process by which a substance absorbs certain wavelengths of light or other forms of energy while reflecting or transmitting others.

words.ex: The self-induced electromotive force can oppose the change in current.
words.ex_cn: 自感电动势可以抵消电流的变化。
words.en: The electromotive force induced in a circuit by a change in the circuit's own magnetic field.

words.ex: The self-inductance of the coil affects the current flow.
words.ex_cn: 线圈的自身电感影响电流的流动。
words.en: Self-inductance is the property of a coil that enables it to produce an electromotive force as a result of a change in the current flowing through it.

words.ex: The phenomenon of self-induction is crucial in understanding electromagnetic circuits.
words.ex_cn: 自感应现象在理解电磁电路中至关重要。
words.en: Self-induction is the property of a circuit whereby an electromotive force is induced in it by a change in the current flowing through it.

words.ex: The packaging used a semi-transparent film to allow customers to see the product inside.
words.ex_cn: 包装使用了一种半透明膜，让顾客可以看到里面的产品。
words.en: A semi-transparent film is a thin layer of material that allows some light to pass through it, making objects on the other side partially visible.

words.ex: The sensitive galvanometer is used to detect very small electrical currents.
words.ex_cn: 灵敏电流计用于检测非常小的电流。
words.en: A sensitive galvanometer is an instrument used to detect and measure small electric currents by the deflection of a needle in a magnetic field.

words.ex: The photographer used a sensitometer to measure the sensitivity of the film.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师使用感光计来测量胶片的感光度。
words.en: A sensitometer is an instrument used to measure the sensitivity of photographic materials to light.

words.tr: phrase. 电容器的串联连接
words.ex: In a series connection of capacitors, the total capacitance is less than the smallest individual capacitance.
words.ex_cn: 在电容器串联中，总电容小于最小的单个电容。
words.en: A series connection of capacitors refers to connecting capacitors end-to-end, so that the same charge flows through each capacitor. The total capacitance of the series is less than any one of the individual capacitors' capacitances.

words.ex: A series-resonance circuit is used in radio receivers to select a particular frequency.
words.ex_cn: 串联谐振电路用于无线电接收器中以选择特定频率。
words.en: A series-resonance circuit is an electrical circuit in which the components are arranged in a series and the circuit resonates at a specific frequency.

words.ex: The power went out because of a short circuit in the wiring.
words.ex_cn: 由于线路中的短路，电源中断了。
words.en: A short circuit is a fault in an electrical circuit where current flows along an unintended path with very low electrical impedance, resulting in an excessive current flowing through the circuit.

words.ex: He has been suffering from short sight since childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他从童年时期就开始受近视的困扰。
words.en: A condition of the eye in which distant objects appear blurred because their images are focused in front of the retina instead of on it.

words.tr: phrase. 分流电阻器；并联电阻
words.ex: A shunt resistor is often used in circuits to bypass a malfunctioning component.
words.ex_cn: 并联电阻常用于电路中，以绕过故障元件。
words.en: A shunt resistor is a device that creates a low resistance path for electric current, allowing it to bypass part of the circuit. It is commonly used to measure current in electrical circuits.

words.ex: The answer must have three significant figures.
words.ex_cn: 答案必须保留三位有效数字。
words.en: A significant figure is a digit in a number that is known with certainty, especially a digit that is used to express the precision of a measurement.

words.ex: Simple harmonic motion is a common type of periodic motion.
words.ex_cn: 简谐运动是一种常见的周期性运动。
words.en: Simple harmonic motion is a type of periodic motion where the restoring force is directly proportional to the displacement and acts in the direction opposite to that of displacement.

words.tr: abbr. 简谐运动；“simple harmonic motion”的缩写
words.ex: The children were playing with the word 'shm' to create fun sounds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在用'shm'这个词来创造有趣的声音。
words.en: An abbreviation for simple harmonic motion, a type of periodic motion where the restoring force is directly proportional to the displacement.

words.ex: A simple harmonic wave is a type of wave that repeats its pattern over time.
words.ex_cn: 简谐波是一种随时间重复其模式的波。
words.en: A simple harmonic wave is a wave that oscillates in time with a sinusoidal pattern, characterized by its amplitude, frequency, and phase.

words.ex: The simple pendulum is often used in physics to illustrate basic principles of oscillation.
words.ex_cn: 简单摆在物理学中常用来阐释振动的基本原理。
words.en: A simple pendulum is a weight suspended from a pivot so that it can swing freely. When a pendulum is displaced sideways from its resting, equilibrium position, it is subject to a restoring force due to gravity that will accelerate it back toward the equilibrium position. When released, the restoring force combined with the pendulum's mass causes it to oscillate about the equilibrium position, swinging back and forth.

words.ex: Sine alternating current is the most common form of electrical power used in homes and industries.
words.ex_cn: 正弦交流电是家庭和工业中最常用的电力形式。
words.en: A type of alternating current (AC) where the current changes direction periodically and its magnitude varies with time in a sinusoidal manner.

words.ex: The single crystal silicon is widely used in the semiconductor industry.
words.ex_cn: 单晶硅在半导体行业中广泛使用。
words.en: A single crystal, also called monocrystal, is a crystalline solid in which the crystal lattice of the entire sample is continuous and unbroken to the edges of the sample, with no grain boundaries.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrated the principle of single slit diffraction.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验展示了单缝衍射的原理。
words.en: Single slit diffraction refers to the phenomenon where light waves spread out after passing through a narrow slit, creating a pattern of bright and dark fringes.

words.ex: Sinusoidal alternating current is commonly used in power distribution systems.
words.ex_cn: 简谐交流电通常用于电力分配系统中。
words.en: An electric current that reverses direction at regular intervals and has a magnitude that varies in a sinusoidal manner.

words.ex: The generator produces a sinusoidal current.
words.ex_cn: 发电机产生正弦电流。
words.en: A sinusoidal current is an electric current that varies with time according to the sine function, commonly used in alternating current (AC) circuits.

words.ex: Sliding friction is a force that opposes the relative motion of two surfaces in contact.
words.ex_cn: 滑动摩擦是阻碍两个接触表面相对运动的力。
words.en: Sliding friction is the resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The sliding friction force opposes the motion of the object.
words.ex_cn: 滑动摩擦力阻碍物体的运动。
words.en: The force that opposes the motion of two surfaces sliding past each other.

words.ex: The soakage in the soil helped the plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中的渗透作用帮助植物生长。
words.en: The process by which a liquid permeates a solid substance.

words.ex: The solar cell powers the small light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能电池为小灯供电。
words.en: A solar cell is a device that converts the energy of sunlight directly into electricity by the photovoltaic effect.

words.ex: The solenoid valve controls the flow of the liquid.
words.ex_cn: 螺线管阀门控制液体的流动。
words.en: A solenoid is a coil of wire, usually cylindrical, in which a magnetic field is created by passing an electric current through it.

words.ex: The solidifying point of water is 0°C.
words.ex_cn: 水的凝固点是0摄氏度。
words.en: The temperature at which a liquid becomes solid.

words.ex: The solvation process involves the interaction between the solute and the solvent.
words.ex_cn: 溶解过程涉及溶质与溶剂之间的相互作用。
words.en: The process by which solvent molecules surround and interact with solute ions or molecules.

words.ex: The sound source of the concert was perfectly placed to ensure everyone could hear the music clearly.
words.ex_cn: n. 音乐会的声源放置得恰到好处，确保每个人都能清晰地听到音乐。
words.en: A sound source is any object or phenomenon that emits sound waves, which can be detected by the human ear or by instruments.

words.ex: The sound velocity in water is faster than in air.
words.ex_cn: 声波在水中的传播速度比在空气中快。
words.en: The speed at which sound waves propagate through a medium.

words.ex: The sound wave traveled through the air.
words.ex_cn: 声波通过空气传播。
words.en: A sound wave is a pattern of disturbance caused by the movement of energy traveling through a medium (such as air, water, or any other liquid or solid matter) as it propagates away from the source of the sound.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.ex: The phenomenon of spark discharge can be observed during thunderstorms.
words.ex_cn: 火花放电现象可以在雷雨期间观察到。
words.en: A spark discharge is a rapid, transient electrical discharge that occurs between two electrodes in a gas, typically air, resulting from the ionization of the gas and the creation of a conductive path.

words.ex: Special relativity explains how time dilation occurs at high velocities.
words.ex_cn: 特殊相对论解释了高速运动时时间膨胀是如何发生的。
words.en: A theory in physics proposed by Albert Einstein, which describes the physics of moving bodies in the absence of gravitational fields, and is based on the principle that the laws of physics are the same for all observers in uniform motion relative to one another.

words.ex: The specific heat capacity of water is higher than that of most other substances.
words.ex_cn: 水的比热容比大多数其他物质都要高。
words.en: The amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a unit mass of a substance by one degree Celsius.

words.tr:
n. 眼镜
n. 景象；奇观；场面；“spectacle”的复数
words.ex: He put on his spectacles to read the small print.
words.ex_cn: 他戴上眼镜阅读小字印刷品。
words.en: Glasses that are worn in front of the eyes to improve vision or to protect the eyes from the sun, dust, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 光谱分析；频谱分析
words.ex: Spectral analysis is widely used in fields such as chemistry, physics, and astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 光谱分析广泛应用于化学、物理和天文学等领域。
words.en: Spectral analysis is a technique used to measure the light spectrum emitted or absorbed by materials to determine their composition.

words.ex: The spectral lines observed in the experiment were consistent with hydrogen emissions.
words.ex_cn: 实验中观察到的光谱线与氢的排放一致。
words.en: A spectral line is a dark or bright line in an otherwise uniform and continuous spectrum, resulting from emission or absorption of light in a narrow frequency range, compared with the nearby frequencies.

words.ex: The spectrograph is used to analyze the light spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 光谱仪用于分析光谱。
words.en: An instrument that separates light into its constituent wavelengths and records the resulting spectrum.

words.ex: Spectrography is used to analyze the chemical composition of stars.
words.ex_cn: 摄谱学被用来分析恒星的化学成分。
words.en: Spectrography refers to the study and analysis of spectra, especially as a method of identifying and quantifying the components of a mixture.

words.ex: Spectroscopy is used to analyze the composition of materials.
words.ex_cn: 光谱学用于分析材料的成分。
words.en: The study of the interaction between matter and electromagnetic radiation as a function of the wavelength or frequency of the radiation.

words.ex: A spherical mirror is used to reflect light in a specific pattern.
words.ex_cn: 球面镜用于以特定模式反射光线。
words.en: A spherical mirror is a mirror whose surface is a section of a sphere. It can be either concave or convex, depending on the side of the sphere used.

words.ex: Spontaneous radiation is a phenomenon observed in quantum systems.
words.ex_cn: 自发辐射是量子系统中观察到的一种现象。
words.en: Spontaneous radiation refers to the process by which a quantum mechanical system transitions from an excited energy state to a lower energy state and emits energy in the form of radiation without any external influence.

words.ex: The shopkeeper used a spring balance to weigh the vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 店主用弹簧秤来称蔬菜的重量。
words.en: A spring balance is a device that measures weight by the tension of a spring.

words.ex: A stabilized current supply is essential for maintaining consistent performance in electronic devices.
words.ex_cn: 稳流电源对于维持电子设备的稳定性能至关重要。
words.en: A stabilized current supply refers to a power source that provides a constant current output, regardless of changes in load or input voltage, ensuring the stable operation of electronic devices.

words.ex: The stabilized voltage supply ensures a constant output voltage under varying load conditions.
words.ex_cn: 稳压电源在负载变化的情况下确保输出电压恒定。
words.en: A power supply that maintains a constant voltage level despite variations in load or input voltage.

words.ex: Standard atmospheric pressure is used as a reference in many scientific measurements.
words.ex_cn: 标准大气压被用作许多科学测量中的参考。
words.en: Standard atmospheric pressure is the pressure exerted by the weight of air in the atmosphere of Earth at sea level, defined as 101,325 Pa (Pascals).

words.ex: The lab technician used a standard cell to calibrate the voltmeter.
words.ex_cn: 实验室技术员使用标准电池来校准电压表。
words.en: A standard cell is a type of battery that is widely used in electronic devices for its reliability and consistent output.

words.ex: In a standing wave, the nodes and antinodes are stationary.
words.ex_cn: 在驻波中，节点和反节点是固定的。
words.en: A wave that remains in a constant position, characterized by points of no movement (nodes) and points of maximum movement (antinodes).

words.tr: phrase. 静摩擦；干摩擦；库仑摩擦
words.ex: Static friction prevents the box from sliding down the ramp.
words.ex_cn: 静摩擦力阻止箱子沿着斜坡滑动。
words.en: Static friction is the force that resists the initiation of sliding motion between two surfaces in contact but at rest relative to each other.

words.ex: The static friction force prevents the object from moving initially.
words.ex_cn: 静摩擦力阻止物体最初移动。
words.en: The force that resists the initiation of sliding motion between two surfaces in contact.

words.ex: In quantum mechanics, the system tends to settle into a stationary state.
words.ex_cn: 在量子力学中，系统往往会稳定到一个稳定态。
words.en: A stationary state is a quantum state with all observables independent of time. In quantum mechanics, a stationary state is an eigenstate of the Hamiltonian—it corresponds to a definite value of energy, called the energy level.

words.ex: The circuit is designed to operate with a steady current source.
words.ex_cn: 该电路设计为与恒流源一起工作。
words.en: A power supply that provides a constant current regardless of changes in load resistance, commonly used in electronic circuits.

words.tr: phrase. 恒定电流；稳恒电流
words.ex: A steady current is necessary for the proper functioning of many electronic devices.
words.ex_cn: 许多电子设备的正常工作需要稳定的电流。
words.en: A steady current refers to an electric current that does not fluctuate in magnitude or direction over time.

words.ex: A steady voltage source is essential for maintaining the performance of electronic devices.
words.ex_cn: 稳定的电压源对于维持电子设备的性能至关重要。
words.en: A steady voltage source is a power source that maintains a constant voltage level regardless of the load or changes in the input.

words.ex: The steam point of water is 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水的蒸汽点是100摄氏度。
words.en: The temperature at which a liquid boils and turns to vapor under standard atmospheric pressure.

words.ex: The stiffness of the metal beam helps it support heavy weight.
words.ex_cn: 金属梁的刚度使其能够承受重物。
words.en: The quality or condition of being stiff; rigidity.

words.ex: Stimulated radiation is the basis for laser technology.
words.ex_cn: 受激辐射是激光技术的基础。
words.en: Stimulated radiation refers to the process by which an incoming photon of a specific frequency interacts with an excited atomic electron, causing it to drop to a lower energy level and emit a photon of the same frequency, phase, and direction.

words.ex: He used a stopwatch to time the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用秒表计时比赛。
words.en: A stopwatch is a watch that can be started and stopped by pressing a button, used for timing events accurately.

words.ex: The process of sublimation can be used to purify substances.
words.ex_cn: 升华过程可以用来提纯物质。
words.en: The process by which a substance changes directly from a solid to a gas without becoming a liquid first.

words.ex: The material begins to superconduct at temperatures below 10 K.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料在温度低于10K时开始显示超导性。
words.en: To allow electricity to pass through without resistance, typically at very low temperatures.

words.ex: The discovery of superconductivity has revolutionized the field of physics.
words.ex_cn: 超导电性的发现彻底改变了物理学领域。
words.en: Superconductivity is a phenomenon of exactly zero electrical resistance and expulsion of magnetic fields occurring in certain materials when cooled below a characteristic critical temperature.

words.ex: The superconductor carries electricity without losing energy.
words.ex_cn: 超导体在传输电力时不会损失能量。
words.en: A superconductor is a material that can conduct electricity without resistance when it is cooled below a certain temperature.

words.tr: phrase. 叠加原理；指在物理或数学系统中，多个作用或状态可以线性叠加，总效果等于各单独效果之和
words.ex: The superposition principle is crucial in understanding wave interference.
words.ex_cn: 超叠原理在理解波的干涉中至关重要。
words.en: The superposition principle is a fundamental principle in physics stating that, for all linear systems, the net response at a given place and time caused by two or more stimuli is the sum of the responses which would have been caused by each stimulus individually.

words.ex: The superposition theorem is widely used in circuit analysis to simplify complex calculations.
words.ex_cn: 叠加定理广泛应用于电路分析中，以简化复杂的计算。
words.en: The superposition theorem is a principle in electrical engineering that states that in any linear network containing multiple sources, the response in any element is the sum of the responses obtained by each source acting alone, with all other sources replaced by their internal impedances.

words.ex: The market for smartphones is experiencing supersaturation.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机市场正经历着过度饱和。
words.en: Supersaturation is a state of a solution that contains more of the dissolved material than could be dissolved by the solvent under normal circumstances.

words.ex: The jet flew at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: A speed that is faster than the speed of sound.

words.ex: Medical imaging often uses supersonic waves to create detailed images of the body.
words.ex_cn: 医学成像经常使用超声波来创建身体内部的详细图像。
words.en: A supersonic wave is a wave that travels at a speed greater than the speed of sound in a given medium.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasound waves to examine the fetus.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用超声波来检查胎儿。
words.en: A sound wave with a frequency above the upper limit of human hearing, used in medical imaging and other applications.

words.tr: phrase. 电源变压器；供电变压器
words.ex: The supply transformer is crucial for stabilizing the voltage in the electrical system.
words.ex_cn: 供电变压器对于稳定电力系统中的电压至关重要。
words.en: A device that changes the voltage of an electrical supply, typically for power distribution.

words.ex: The surface resistance of the material was measured to be very high.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料的表面电阻被测得非常高。
words.en: Surface resistance refers to the opposition that a material presents to the flow of electric current across its surface.

words.ex: Surface tension allows small insects to walk on water.
words.ex_cn: 表面张力使得小昆虫能在水面上行走。
words.en: Surface tension is the elastic tendency of a fluid surface which makes it acquire the least surface area possible. Surface tension allows insects (e.g. water striders), usually denser than water, to float and stride on a water surface.

words.ex: In physics, a system of concurrent forces is a set of forces whose lines of action all pass through a single point.
words.ex_cn: 在物理学中，共点力系统是指所有力的作用线都通过同一点的力系统。
words.en: A system of concurrent forces refers to a set of forces whose lines of action all intersect at a single point. This concept is crucial in physics for analyzing the equilibrium and motion of objects under the influence of multiple forces.

words.ex: The study of the system of particles involves understanding the interactions between individual particles.
words.ex_cn: 质点系的研究涉及理解单个粒子之间的相互作用。
words.en: A system of particles refers to a collection of particles that are considered together because of their interactions or common properties, often analyzed in physics to study motion and forces.

words.ex: The International System of Units (SI) is widely used in science and engineering.
words.ex_cn: 国际单位制（SI）在科学和工程领域被广泛使用。
words.en: A system of units is a set of units of measurement which can be used to specify anything which can be measured and were historically important, regulated and defined because of trade and internal commerce.

words.ex: The experiment was flawed by a systematic error in the measurement equipment.
words.ex_cn: 实验因测量设备中的系统误差而存在缺陷。
words.en: A systematic error is a consistent, repeatable error associated with faulty equipment or a flawed experiment design.

words.ex: The terminal voltage of the battery decreases as the load increases.
words.ex_cn: 随着负载的增加，电池的终端电压下降。
words.en: The voltage across the terminals of a battery or other electrical device when it is connected to a circuit and current is flowing.

words.tr: phrase. 万有引力定律；重力定律
words.ex: The law of gravity explains why objects fall to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 引力定律解释了为什么物体落向地面。
words.en: The law of gravity is a physical law that describes the gravitational attraction between bodies with mass.

words.tr: phrase. 磁地球；具有磁场的地球
words.ex: The magnetic Earth plays a crucial role in protecting our planet from harmful solar winds.
words.ex_cn: 地球磁场在保护我们的星球免受有害太阳风的影响方面起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: The term 'magnetic earth' refers to the Earth's magnetic field, which is a magnetic field that extends from the Earth's interior out into space, where it interacts with the solar wind.

words.ex: The theorem of kinetic energy helps us understand how the work done on an object changes its speed.
words.ex_cn: 动能定理帮助我们理解对物体做功如何改变其速度。
words.en: The theorem of kinetic energy is a principle in physics that relates the work done on an object to the change in its kinetic energy.

words.ex: The theorem of momentum explains how the momentum of a system changes when it is acted upon by external forces.
words.ex_cn: 动量定理解释了当系统受到外力作用时，其动量如何变化。
words.en: The theorem of momentum states that the rate of change of momentum of a body is equal to the force applied to it.

words.ex: Theoretical physics often involves complex mathematical models to predict natural phenomena.
words.ex_cn: 理论物理学经常使用复杂的数学模型来预测自然现象。
words.en: Theoretical physics is a branch of physics that employs mathematical models and abstractions of physical objects and systems to rationalize, explain and predict natural phenomena.

words.ex: The thermal capacity of water is higher than that of most other substances.
words.ex_cn: 水的比热容高于大多数其他物质。
words.en: The amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a substance by one degree Celsius.

words.ex: The engine converts chemical energy into thermal energy.
words.ex_cn: 这台发动机将化学能转化为热能。
words.en: Thermal energy is the internal energy of an object due to the kinetic energy of its atoms and/or molecules.

words.ex: The system will eventually reach thermal equilibrium with its surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 系统最终会与其周围环境达到热平衡。
words.en: Thermal equilibrium is a state in which all parts of a system are at the same temperature, and there is no net flow of thermal energy between them.

words.ex: The thermal motion of molecules increases with temperature.
words.ex_cn: 分子的热运动随着温度的升高而增加。
words.en: The random movement of particles in a substance as a result of thermal energy.

words.ex: The insulation is designed to reduce thermal transmission.
words.ex_cn: 这种隔热材料设计用于减少热传递。
words.en: The process by which heat is transferred from one place to another.

words.ex: The thermodynamic scale of temperature is based on absolute zero.
words.ex_cn: 热力学温标基于绝对零度。
words.en: The thermodynamic scale of temperature is a scale for measuring temperature based on the laws of thermodynamics, which is independent of the properties of any specific material.

words.tr: phrase. 热力学温度；以热力学定律为基础定义的温度，其单位为开尔文（K）
words.ex: Thermodynamic temperature is measured in Kelvin.
words.ex_cn: 热力学温度以开尔文为单位测量。
words.en: Thermodynamic temperature is an absolute measure of temperature and is one of the principal parameters of thermodynamics.

words.ex: The Celsius and Fahrenheit are two common types of thermometric scales.
words.ex_cn: 摄氏度和华氏度是两种常见的温标。
words.en: A thermometric scale is a system of measuring temperature, typically defined by fixed points and increments.

words.ex: The explosion of a hydrogen bomb is a result of thermonuclear reaction.
words.ex_cn: 氢弹的爆炸是热核反应的结果。
words.en: A thermonuclear reaction is a process in which atomic nuclei combine at very high temperatures to form heavier nuclei, releasing a large amount of energy.

words.ex: He wears glasses with thick lenses to correct his vision.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着厚透镜的眼镜来矫正视力。
words.en: A thick lens is a lens that has a significant thickness compared to its focal length, affecting the way light passes through it.

words.ex: A thin lens can focus light to a point.
words.ex_cn: 薄透镜可以将光线聚焦到一个点。
words.en: A thin lens is a lens with a thickness that is negligible compared to the radii of curvature of its surfaces. It is used in various optical devices to focus or disperse light.

words.ex: The spacecraft reached the third cosmic velocity and escaped the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 航天器达到了第三宇宙速度并逃离了太阳系。
words.en: The minimum speed needed for an object to break free from the gravitational attraction of the sun and the solar system, enabling it to travel into interstellar space.

words.ex: Thomson's model of the atom was later replaced by Rutherford's model.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆逊的原子模型后来被卢瑟福的模型所取代。
words.en: Thomson's model refers to the early atomic model proposed by J.J. Thomson, which described the atom as a sphere of positive charge with electrons embedded within it.

words.ex: The factory uses three-phase alternating current for its heavy machinery.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用三相交流电为其重型机械供电。
words.en: An electric current that reverses direction at regular intervals, typically used in power distribution, consisting of three phases to improve efficiency and power delivery.

words.ex: The torsion balance was used to measure the gravitational force between two objects.
words.ex_cn: 扭秤被用来测量两个物体之间的引力。
words.en: A torsion balance is a scientific instrument that measures very small forces by the torsion or twisting of a wire or thread.

words.ex: Total internal reflection is a key principle in fiber optic technology.
words.ex_cn: 全内反射是光纤技术中的一个关键原理。
words.en: Total internal reflection is a phenomenon which occurs when a propagated wave strikes a medium boundary at an angle larger than a particular critical angle with respect to the normal to the surface.

words.ex: Total reflection is a phenomenon often observed in fiber optics.
words.ex_cn: 全反射是光纤中常见的一种现象。
words.en: Total reflection is a phenomenon that occurs when a wave strikes a medium boundary at an angle larger than a particular critical angle with respect to the normal to the surface. If the refractive index is lower on the other side of the boundary and the incident angle is greater than the critical angle, the wave cannot pass through and is entirely reflected.

words.ex: The transmission line was designed to carry high-voltage electricity over long distances.
words.ex_cn: 这条传输线设计用于长距离传输高压电。
words.en: A conductor or system of conductors used for the transmission of electrical energy or signals.

words.tr: n. 透射比；透射率；透射系数
words.ex: The transmissivity of the glass allows a significant amount of light to pass through.
words.ex_cn: 这种玻璃的透射率使得大量的光线能够通过。
words.en: Transmissivity refers to the ability of a material to transmit radiation, especially light.

words.ex: A transverse wave moves the particles of the medium perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation.
words.ex_cn: 横波使介质的粒子在与波传播方向垂直的方向上移动。
words.en: A transverse wave is a moving wave that consists of oscillations occurring perpendicular (or right angled) to the direction of energy transfer.

words.ex: The triboelectrification effect is observed when two different materials are rubbed together.
words.ex_cn: 当两种不同的材料摩擦时，可以观察到摩擦电化效应。
words.en: The process by which two materials become electrically charged after they come into contact and are then separated, often due to friction.

words.ex: The triode was a key component in early electronic amplifiers.
words.ex_cn: 三极管是早期电子放大器的关键组件。
words.en: A triode is an electronic amplifying device consisting of three electrodes inside a vacuum tube: a cathode, an anode, and a control grid.

words.ex: The musician used a tuning fork to calibrate the piano.
words.ex_cn: 音乐家使用音叉来校准钢琴。
words.en: A tuning fork is a small steel instrument with two prongs that produces a fixed tone when struck, used especially for tuning musical instruments.

words.ex: Turbulent flow is characterized by irregular fluctuations.
words.ex_cn: 湍流的特点是速度和方向的不规则波动。
words.en: A flow of fluid in which the velocity at any point varies erratically.

words.ex: Exposure to ultraviolet rays can cause skin damage.
words.ex_cn: 暴露在紫外线下会导致皮肤损伤。
words.en: Ultraviolet rays are a form of electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible light but longer than X-rays. They are found in sunlight and can cause chemical reactions, such as sunburn.

words.ex: The umbra of the moon completely obscured the sun during the eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 月球的暗影在日食期间完全遮蔽了太阳。
words.en: The fully shaded inner region of a shadow cast by an opaque object, especially the area on the earth or moon experiencing the total phase of an eclipse.

words.ex: The undulatory motion of the sea is mesmerizing.
words.ex_cn: 海浪的波动令人着迷。
words.en: Having a wave-like motion or appearance.

words.ex: In a uniform dielectric, the electric field is constant throughout the medium.
words.ex_cn: 在均匀介质中，电场在整个介质中是恒定的。
words.en: An insulating material with identical electrical properties throughout its volume.

words.ex: In a uniform electric field, the electric force acting on a charged particle is constant.
words.ex_cn: 在均匀电场中，作用在带电粒子上的电场力是恒定的。
words.en: A uniform electric field is an electric field that has the same strength and direction at every point in space.

words.tr: phrase. 均匀电场；匀强磁场
words.ex: A uniform magnetic field is essential for precise experiments.
words.ex_cn: 均匀磁场对于精确实验至关重要。
words.en: A uniform magnetic field is a magnetic field that has the same strength and direction at every point within it.

words.ex: Uniform motion is characterized by constant velocity.
words.ex_cn: 匀速运动的特点是速度恒定。
words.en: Uniform motion refers to the motion of an object at a constant speed in a straight line, with no acceleration.

words.ex: The car is moving in uniform rectilinear motion at a constant speed of 60 km/h.
words.ex_cn: n. 这辆车以60公里/小时的恒定速度做匀速直线运动。
words.en: Uniform rectilinear motion is the motion of an object moving in a straight line at a constant speed, with no acceleration.

words.ex: The speed of light is a universal constant in a vacuum.
words.ex_cn: 光在真空中的速度是一个普适常数。
words.en: A universal constant is a physical quantity that is generally believed to be both universal in nature and constant in time.

words.ex: Newton's law of universal gravitation explains the gravitational force between any two objects.
words.ex_cn: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了任意两个物体之间的引力。
words.en: The force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center. The force of gravity keeps all of the planets in orbit around the sun.

words.ex: Old radios use vacuum tubes to work.
words.ex_cn: 旧收音机使用真空管工作。
words.en: A vacuum tube is a device that controls electric current flow in a high vacuum between electrodes to which an electric potential difference has been applied.

words.ex: The amplitude of the sound is very high.
words.ex_cn: 声音的振幅非常高。
words.en: The extent or range of a quality, property, process, or phenomenon: magnitude.

words.ex: The technician used a vernier caliper to measure the small part.
words.ex_cn: 技师使用游标卡尺来测量这个小部件。
words.en: A vernier is a small movable scale that slides along a main scale and is used to measure fractional parts of the divisions on the main scale.

words.ex: The engineer used a vernier caliper to measure the diameter of the bolt.
words.ex_cn: 工程师使用游标卡尺来测量螺栓的直径。
words.en: A vernier caliper is a device used to measure the distance between two opposite sides of an object with high accuracy.

words.ex: The vibrational wave propagated through the medium at a specific frequency.
words.ex_cn: 振动波以特定的频率通过介质传播。
words.en: A wave characterized by vibrations, especially in the context of physics where it refers to the propagation of oscillations through a medium.

words.ex: The viewing angle of the monitor is wide enough for multiple users to see the screen clearly.
words.ex_cn: 显示器的视角足够宽，多个用户可以清晰地看到屏幕。
words.en: The angle at which something, especially a screen, is viewed.

words.ex: The viewing field of the microscope is quite narrow.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜的视场相当狭窄。
words.en: The area that is visible through an optical instrument or to the naked eye.

words.ex: The virtual image appears to be behind the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 虚像看起来像是位于镜子后面。
words.en: An image from which light rays appear to diverge, although they actually do not pass through it; it cannot be projected on a screen.

words.ex: A voltage divider can be used to step down a high voltage to a lower one.
words.ex_cn: 分压器可以用来将高电压降到较低的电压。
words.en: A voltage divider is a simple circuit which turns a large voltage into a smaller one. Using just two series resistors and an input voltage, we can create an output voltage that is a fraction of the input.

words.tr: phrase. 分压电路；一种通过串联电阻将输入电压按比例分配为较低输出电压的电子电路
words.ex: The voltage divider circuit is widely used in electronic devices to provide different voltage levels.
words.ex_cn: 电压分压器电路广泛用于电子设备中，以提供不同的电压电平。
words.en: A voltage divider circuit is an electrical circuit that produces an output voltage (Vout) that is a fraction of its input voltage (Vin). Voltage division is the result of distributing the input voltage among the components of the divider.

words.ex: The voltaic cell was the precursor to modern batteries.
words.ex_cn: 伏打电池是现代电池的前身。
words.en: A voltaic cell is an electrochemical cell that derives electrical energy from spontaneous redox reactions taking place within the cell. It consists of two different metals connected by a salt bridge, or individual half-cells separated by a porous membrane.

words.ex: The electrician used a voltmeter to check the electrical system.
words.ex_cn: 电工使用电压表检查电气系统。
words.en: A voltmeter is an instrument used for measuring the electric potential difference between two points in an electric circuit.

words.ex: The voltmeter-ammeter method is used to measure the resistance of an electrical circuit.
words.ex_cn: 电压-电流表法用于测量电路的电阻。
words.en: A technique for measuring electrical resistance by separately measuring voltage and current.

words.ex: The vortex electric field is generated by changing magnetic fields.
words.ex_cn: 涡旋电场是由变化的磁场产生的。
words.en: An electric field that circulates around a central axis, often associated with magnetic fields.

words.ex: The wave crest broke on the shore.
words.ex_cn: 波峰拍打在岸边。
words.en: The highest part of a wave.

words.ex: The wave equation is fundamental in the study of waves.
words.ex_cn: 波动方程在波的研究中是基础性的。
words.en: A wave equation is a differential equation that describes the propagation of waves, such as sound waves, light waves, and water waves, through a medium or in a vacuum.

words.ex: Wave theory explains how light behaves like waves.
words.ex_cn: 波动论解释了光如何像波一样行为。
words.en: Wave theory is a theory that explains the behavior of light, sound, or other waves as they travel through various mediums, based on the concept that these phenomena can be described as waves.

words.ex: The wave velocity of light in a vacuum is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.
words.ex_cn: 光在真空中的波速大约是每秒300,000公里。
words.en: The speed at which a wave travels through a medium, typically measured in meters per second.

words.ex: Wave-particle dualism is a fundamental concept in quantum mechanics.
words.ex_cn: 波粒二象性是量子力学中的一个基本概念。
words.en: Wave-particle dualism is the concept in quantum mechanics that every particle or quantum entity may exhibit properties of both particles and waves.

words.ex: The sun produces white light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出白光。
words.en: White light is light that contains all the colors of the visible spectrum in equal amounts.

words.tr: phrase. 威尔姆·康拉德·伦琴
words.ex: Wilhelm Conrad Rntgen discovered X-rays in 1895.
words.ex_cn: 威廉·康拉德·伦琴在1895年发现了X射线。
words.en: Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen was a German physicist, who, on 8 November 1895, produced and detected electromagnetic radiation in a wavelength range known as X-rays or Röntgen rays, an achievement that earned him the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901.

words.ex: Wilhelm Weber's contributions to the field of electromagnetism were groundbreaking.
words.ex_cn: 威廉·韦伯在电磁学领域的贡献具有开创性。
words.en: A German physicist (1804–1891) known for his work in electromagnetism and the Weber-Fechner law.

words.ex: The work function is a critical parameter in determining the efficiency of photoelectric devices.
words.ex_cn: 工作函数是决定光电设备效率的关键参数。
words.en: In physics, the work function is the minimum energy needed to remove an electron from a solid to a point immediately outside the solid surface.

words.tr: phrase. 杨氏实验（指托马斯·杨进行的双缝干涉实验，用于证明光的波动性）
words.ex: Young's experiment demonstrated the wave nature of light by showing interference patterns.
words.ex_cn: 杨氏实验通过展示干涉图案证明了光的波动性。
words.en: An experiment conducted by Thomas Young that demonstrated the wave nature of light by showing interference patterns.

words.ex: The zero line is essential for maintaining the balance of the electrical circuit.
words.ex_cn: 零线对于维持电路的平衡至关重要。
words.en: The zero line is a reference line on a graph or chart that represents the baseline or starting point for measurements.

words.tr: phrase. α射线；阿尔法射线（由放射性元素释放出的高速运动的氦原子核组成的粒子流）
words.ex: Alpha rays are the least penetrating of the three types of ionizing radiation.
words.ex_cn: 阿尔法射线是三种电离辐射中穿透力最弱的一种。
words.en: An alpha ray is a stream of alpha particles emitted by a radioactive substance, consisting of two protons and two neutrons, identical to a helium nucleus.

words.ex: Beta-rays are a form of ionizing radiation.
words.ex_cn: β射线是一种电离辐射。
words.en: A stream of beta particles emitted by radioactive decay.

words.ex: He gave an enumeration of all the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他列出了书架上所有的书。
words.en: The act of naming things one by one or a list of items.

words.tr: n. 梯形；不等边四边形
words.ex: The shape is a trapezoid with two parallel sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状是一个有两条平行边的梯形。
words.en: A flat shape with four straight sides, where one pair of opposite sides is parallel.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: The midpoint of the line is at 5.
words.ex_cn: 这条线的中点在5处。
words.en: A midpoint is the exact middle point of something, such as a line segment, where it is equally distant from both ends.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The approximation of pi is 3.14.
words.ex_cn: π的近似值是3.14。
words.en: An approximation is a fact, object, or description which is similar to something else, but which is not exactly the same.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: He won three successive championships.
words.ex_cn: 他连续赢得了三届冠军。
words.en: Following one after the other without interruption.

words.ex: The two lines are parallel lines and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行线，从不相交。
words.en: Lines that are always the same distance apart and never meet.

words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the fraction.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal point is a dot used to separate the whole number part from the fractional part of a number in decimal notation.

words.ex: The line touches the circle at one point and is a tangent.
words.ex_cn: 这条线与圆在一个点相切，是一条切线。
words.en: A tangent is a straight line or plane that touches a curve or curved surface at a point, but if extended does not cross it at that point. In a more general sense, it can also refer to a sudden digression or change of course.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: His comment was tangential to the main topic.
words.ex_cn: 他的评论离题了。
words.en: If you describe something as tangential, you mean that it has only a slight or indirect connection with the thing you are concerned with, and is therefore not worth considering seriously.

words.ex: The bee built a hexagon with wax.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造了一个六边形。
words.en: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: The line bisects the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 这条线将角平分为两个相等的部分。
words.en: To divide something into two equal parts.

words.tr: n. 取消；撤销；作废；中止；
words.ex: The flight cancellation made us wait for a new ticket.
words.ex_cn: 航班取消让我们不得不等待新的机票。
words.en: The act of cancelling something; a situation in which something that has been arranged is stopped from happening.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；外形；等高线
v. 画轮廓（画等高线）
adj. 显示轮廓的
words.ex: The map shows the contour of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山的轮廓。
words.en: The outline of a figure, body, or mass, especially the curved shape of a surface.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.ex: The vertex of the triangle is at the top.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的顶点在顶部。
words.en: The highest point of something; the top or apex.

words.ex: The distance between the two towns is 10 kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 两个城镇之间的距离是10公里。
words.en: The amount of space between two places or things.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He draws triangles in geometry class.
words.ex_cn: 他在几何课上画三角形。
words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.ex: The divisor is 5 in this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 在这个数学题中，除数是5。
words.en: A divisor is a number by which another number is to be divided.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The stop sign is an octagon.
words.ex_cn: 交通标志是一个八边形。
words.en: An octagon is a polygon with eight sides and eight angles.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr:
adj. 对角线的；斜的
n. 对角线；斜线
words.ex: The square has two diagonal lines.
words.ex_cn: 这个正方形有两条对角线。
words.en: A diagonal line or movement goes in a sloping direction, for example, from one corner of a square across to the opposite corner.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: The preceding chapter explains the basics.
words.ex_cn: 前一章解释了基础知识。
words.en: Existing or coming before something else in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: The shape has four equal sides and is called a rhombus.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条相等的边，叫做菱形。
words.en: A rhombus is a quadrilateral all of whose sides are of equal length.

words.tr:
adj. 切的；割的；交叉的
n. 正割；割线
words.ex: The secant line intersects the circle at two points.
words.ex_cn: 割线在两个点与圆相交。
words.en: In mathematics, a secant is a straight line that intersects a curve at two or more points.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.tr: n. 阐述者；拥护者；代表者；指数
words.ex: He is the exponent of modern education reform.
words.ex_cn: 他是现代教育改革的阐述者。
words.en: An exponent is someone who supports and explains a particular idea, theory, or system, or a symbol that shows how many times a number is to be multiplied by itself.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The point has an ordinate of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的纵坐标是5。
words.en: In mathematics, an ordinate is the y-coordinate of a point in a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.ex: The expression is factorable into two simple parts.
words.ex_cn: 这个表达式可以分解为两个简单的部分。
words.en: Capable of being factored, especially in mathematics, referring to expressions that can be broken down into products of simpler expressions.

words.tr:
n. 中位数；（三角形的）中线
adj. 中间值的；中间的
words.ex: The median of 3, 5, and 7 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 3、5和7的中位数是5。
words.en: The median is the middle number in a sorted, ascending or descending, list of numbers and can be more descriptive of that data set than the average.

words.ex: Everyone deserves equality in education.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应享有教育平等。
words.en: Equality is the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: This is the hundredth time he has been late.
words.ex_cn: 这是他第100次迟到了。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number 100 in a series.

words.tr: n. 象形文字；象形图；古代石壁画
words.ex: The ancient people used pictograph to show stories.
words.ex_cn: 古代人用象形图来讲述故事。
words.en: A pictograph is a pictorial symbol for a word or phrase. Pictographs were used as the earliest known form of writing, examples having been discovered in Egypt and Mesopotamia from before 3000 BC.

words.tr:
adj. 无数的；
n. 无数；
words.ex: There are myriad stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
words.en: A myriad of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: The teacher used a pointer to show the map on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一根指物棒指着墙上的地图。
words.en: A pointer is a piece of advice or information which helps you to understand a situation or to find a way of making progress.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: The triangle has three equal sides and is equilateral.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条相等的边，是等边的。
words.en: Having all sides or faces equal.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.ex: They paid five dollars apiece for the tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他们每人五美元买了票。
words.en: If something is given or sold apiece, each person is given or sold one, or each thing is sold for a particular amount.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He will enumerate the steps clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他将清晰地列出这些步骤。
words.en: To enumerate means to mention things one by one.

words.tr: n. 几率；不利条件；不平等；
words.ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票的几率非常低。
words.en: The odds are the chances that a particular thing will happen.

words.tr:
adj. 四边的；四边形的
n. 四边形
words.ex: The quadrilateral shape has four sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个四边的形状有四条边。
words.en: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.ex: He halved the cake into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 他把蛋糕切成两等份。
words.en: To halve something means to divide it into two equal parts, or to reduce it by half.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.ex: The temperature is 30 degrees today.
words.ex_cn: 今天气温是30度。
words.en: A degree is a unit of measurement for angles, or a qualification given to a student by a college or university after they have completed a course of study.

words.ex: The track is elliptical in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个跑道是椭圆形的。
words.en: Something that is elliptical has the shape of an ellipse or is characterized by the omission of words that are understood to be obvious.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He sings and plays guitar simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边弹吉他。
words.en: If two or more things happen simultaneously, they happen at exactly the same time.

words.tr:
v. 误算；算错；数错
n. 计算错误
words.ex: He miscounted the apples and thought there were ten.
words.ex_cn: 他数错了苹果，以为有十个。
words.en: To count incorrectly or make a mistake in counting.

words.tr: n. 从0到9的任一数字；手指；脚趾；
words.ex: The password has four digits.
words.ex_cn: 这个密码有四位数字。
words.en: A digit is a written symbol for any of the numbers 0 to 9.

words.ex: The child drew a decagon with ten sides.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一个有十条边的十边形。
words.en: A decagon is a polygon with ten sides and ten angles.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.ex: The numbers show convergence over time.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字随时间显示出收敛。
words.en: The process or state of converging; the coming together of two or more things to a common point or conclusion.

words.ex: The two lines intersect at point A.
words.ex_cn: 两条线在点A相交。
words.en: If two or more lines or roads intersect, they meet or cross each other.

words.ex: He picked a number randomly from the hat.
words.ex_cn: 他从帽子里随机抽了一个数字。
words.en: If something is done randomly, it is done without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.ex: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.
words.ex_cn: 斜边是直角三角形中最长的一条边。
words.en: The side opposite the right angle in a right-angled triangle.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: n. 四分之一圆周；象限；四分仪
words.ex: The point lies in the first quadrant of the circle.
words.ex_cn: 这个点位于圆的四分之一圆周的第一象限。
words.en: A quadrant is one of the four equal parts into which a circle is divided by two lines that cross each other at right angles.

words.ex: He poured 50 centiliters of water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他往杯子里倒了50厘升水。
words.en: A unit of volume equal to one hundredth of a liter.

words.tr: adv. 无限期地；不确定地；
words.ex: The meeting was postponed indefinitely.
words.ex_cn: 会议被无限期推迟了。
words.en: If something will happen indefinitely, it will happen for an unlimited or unknown period of time.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr:
adj. 成比例的；相应的；相称的
v. 使成比例；使适应
words.ex: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚应当与罪行相称。
words.en: If one thing is proportionate to another, it increases or decreases according to the changes in the other thing, and there is a sensible relationship between them.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.tr: adj. 可被整除的；可分的
words.ex: The number 12 is divisible by 3.
words.ex_cn: 12 能被 3 整除。
words.en: Capable of being divided, especially with no remainder.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: This color differs from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色和那个不同。
words.en: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

words.tr: adj. 符合的；一致的；全等的
words.ex: The two shapes are congruent in size.
words.ex_cn: 这两个形状大小相符。
words.en: If one thing is congruent with another, they are similar or fit together well.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The number 5 is an integer.
words.ex_cn: 数字5是一个整数。
words.en: An integer is a whole number that can be positive, negative, or zero.

words.ex: His ratiocination helped him solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他的推理帮助他解开了这个谜题。
words.en: The process of logical reasoning or argumentation.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.tr: n. 球状体；回转椭圆体
words.ex: The earth is not a perfect sphere; it is a spheroid.
words.ex_cn: 地球不是一个完美的球体；它是一个椭球体。
words.en: A spheroid is a three-dimensional shape that is similar to a sphere but not perfectly round, often slightly flattened at the poles.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: The shape has four sides, and opposite sides are parallel; it is a parallelogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条边，对边平行；它是一个平行四边形。
words.en: A parallelogram is a four-sided plane rectilinear figure with opposite sides parallel.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.tr: adj. 同等的；相等的；相当于
words.ex: Lying is tantamount to cheating.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎等于欺骗。
words.en: If you say that one thing is tantamount to a second, more serious thing, you are emphasizing how bad, unacceptable, or unfortunate the first thing is by comparing it to the second.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.ex: The two trees are equidistant from the house.
words.ex_cn: 这两棵树离房子的距离相等。
words.en: Equidistant means being at equal distances from two or more places.

words.ex: He will subdivide the land into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 他将把土地分成两部分。
words.en: If something is subdivided, it is divided into several smaller areas, parts, or sections.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: The triangle is equiangular.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形是等角的。
words.en: Having all angles equal.

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.tr:
adj. 矩形的；长方形的；椭圆形的；椭圆体的
n. 矩形或椭圆形（的物体）
words.ex: The table is oblong in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是长方形的。
words.en: An oblong shape is a shape that is longer than it is wide, with straight sides and right angles.

words.ex: The parity of the numbers is important in this game.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的奇偶性在这个游戏中很重要。
words.en: If there is parity between two things, they are equal to each other.

words.tr: n. 直线；捷径；最短距离
words.ex: The bee made a beeline for the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂径直飞向花朵。
words.en: A direct, straight course or path.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: The cost is proportional to the size.
words.ex_cn: 成本与大小成比例。
words.en: If one amount is proportional to another, the two amounts increase and decrease at the same rate so there is always the same relationship between them.

words.ex: He drew a pentagon, which is a polygon.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个五边形，它是一个多边形。
words.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides and angles.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: She coordinates the team's schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她协调团队的安排。
words.en: If you coordinate an activity, you organize the various people and things involved in it. If you coordinate the different parts of your body, you make them work together efficiently.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.ex: He inscribes his name on the stone.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在石头上。
words.en: To write, mark, or engrave (words, symbols, etc.) on a surface, especially as a formal or permanent record.

words.ex: He extrapolates the trend from last year's data.
words.ex_cn: 他从去年的数据中推断出趋势。
words.en: To extrapolate is to estimate or conclude something by extending or projecting known information.

words.tr: n. [数]弧度; n. （Radian）人名；（罗）拉迪安
words.ex: The angle of 180 degrees is equivalent to π radians.
words.ex_cn: 180度的角相当于π弧度。
words.en: A unit of angular measure equal to the angle at the center of a circle that is subtended by an arc equal in length to the radius of the circle.

words.ex: He drew a scatterplot to show the relationship between height and weight.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个散点图来显示身高和体重之间的关系。
words.en: A scatterplot is a type of plot or mathematical diagram using Cartesian coordinates to display values for typically two variables for a set of data.

words.tr:
adj. [数]多项式的； [生]多词学名的
n. [数]多项式； [生]多词学名
words.ex: The polynomial function can be used to model complex data sets.
words.ex_cn: 多项式函数可以用来模拟复杂的数据集。
words.en: A polynomial is a mathematical expression consisting of variables and coefficients, involving only the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and non-negative integer exponents of variables.

words.ex: The ball follows a parabola when thrown.
words.ex_cn: 球被扔出时沿着抛物线运动。
words.en: A parabola is a symmetrical open plane curve formed by the intersection of a cone with a plane parallel to its side.

chapters.name: 专业词汇 其他数学常用术语：

words.ex: The point has an abscissa of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的横坐标是5。
words.en: The abscissa is the horizontal coordinate in a system of Cartesian coordinates.

words.ex: The absolute value of -5 is 5.
words.ex_cn: -5 的绝对值是 5。
words.en: The magnitude of a real number without regard to its sign.

words.ex: The triangle has an acute angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个锐角。
words.en: An acute angle is an angle that is less than 90 degrees. It is one of the basic types of angles in geometry.

words.ex: An acute triangle has all angles less than 90 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 锐角三角形的所有角度都小于90度。
words.en: A triangle where all three angles are less than 90 degrees.

words.ex: The two angles are adjacent angles.
words.ex_cn: 这两个角是邻角。
words.en: Adjacent angles are two angles that have a common side and a common vertex, but do not overlap.

words.ex: An algebraic expression can include variables, constants, and operations.
